description:
Salary: Start at $800 a month + performance-based bonuses (TOTAL: $1,000–$1,200 a month once trained)

Senior CFMs earn $1,500+ after 6–12 months.



Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



ABOUT US



Young Publisher – 



We are an international digital marketing company working with content creators and online brands. The company has over 85 employees around the world. We've been in the industry since 2019. We're currently serving over 1,000+ high-ticket clients per year.



We provide an 80% done-for-you content and monetization system that helps creators grow, go viral, and turn views into income using short-form content, AI tools, and proven strategies. Our clients are typically beginners or early-stage creators looking to build their brand, gain followers, and generate income online.



We focus on structure, accountability, and long-term growth.

We focus strongly on client delivery and producing client results.



BENEFITS



- Full-time position: 7.5 hours daily, Monday-Friday; 37.5 hours a week

- Flexible schedule: Choose your own hours, as long as you show up for the daily meeting (MANDATORY)

- Stable income: Long-term role with regular, on-time payments

- Supportive team: Collaborative environment without micromanagement

- Growth path: Opportunities to increase responsibilities and earnings

- 100% remote: Work-from-home setup



TASKS



Content & Client Feedback



- Review 50-100 short-form client videos (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) per day in our Slack feedback channel -before they are published

- Give constructive, actionable feedback on hooks (verbal/headline/visual), scripting, pacing, editing, and CTA, making sure each client knows exactly how to improve

- Cross-reference each piece of content with client niche, experience, and goals as outlined in their files

- Review previous feedback to ensure consistency and avoid contradictions

- Quality-control content ideas created by our Content Research Experts before delivery to the client, ensuring fit with niche, experience, and likely performance

- Oversee workload balance among Content Research Experts and make sure no one on the team is overloaded or underutilized

- Respond to client questions or tech issues in Slack within 24 hours

- Be tough but fair—only approve content that meets quality standards



Progress Tracking



- Complete daily End-of-Day (EOD) reports

- Attend daily team meeting (mandatory, 3pm CET)

- Keep internal feedback and client progress records up to date



REQUIREMENTS (MUST-HAVE)



- C1+ English (written), with perfect grammar and clear, professional responses

- Significant experience creating or reviewing short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts

- Organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable internet and a quiet, professional home workspace

- Accountability mindset and deadline commitment

- Long-term commitment, eager to master a workflow and have direct impact on client success



BONUS SKILLS (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience supporting creators and social media beginners, especially ages 45+

- Familiarity with AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, etc.

- Strong understanding of trends/strategy for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts



WHY JOIN US?



- Monthly Performance Bonuses: Rewarding high-quality feedback, consistent task completion, and strong teamwork.

- Fully Covered Software: Access to all necessary premium tools and software provided.

- Great Work-Life Balance: Sustainable hours with no graveyard shifts.

- Professional Growth: Accelerate your skill set through regular feedback and advanced training.



HOW TO APPLY

title: Video Editor
description:
I’m looking for a creative video editor to turn my Twitch footage into entertaining, polished videos. My current content mainly features Fortnite and Dead by Daylight, with a focus on comedy, memorable gameplay moments, and occasional trivia-based content. This is a BRAND NEW channel, you will have a lot of creative control over the videos in terms of adding sounds, images, editing style, etc. I am new to Twitch so I will be open to your feedback.



I’ll provide timestamps and general direction for each video. You’ll be responsible for shaping the footage into a finished video with strong pacing, clean edits, and added comedic value.



Responsibilities

Edit Twitch gameplay footage based on provided timestamps and direction

Create engaging, funny videos with strong pacing and comedic timing

Use sound effects, music, images, captions, zooms, and other visual elements where appropriate

Enhance jokes and entertaining moments without over-editing

Edit trivia-based content in a clear and engaging way

Deliver polished videos that are ready to upload

Communicate clearly and meet agreed-upon deadlines



Ideal Candidate

Has previous experience editing Twitch, gaming, or similar online content

Understands comedic timing and can recognize moments worth emphasizing

Can add humor through creative audio, images, captions, and visual effects

Is familiar with gaming content—experience with Fortnite or Dead by Daylight is a plus

Can follow direction while also bringing original ideas to each edit

Is dependable, responsive, and open to feedback



The workload will vary depending on how much content I have available, so hours will not be consistently the same every week. This is a good opportunity for someone interested in ongoing freelance work and growing with a Twitch channel. 



To Apply please include:

A short introduction

Examples of gaming or Twitch content you’ve edited

Your typical turnaround time

The editing software you use



Applicants with a portfolio demonstrating comedy-focused gaming edits will be strongly preferred.

title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
description:
Senior Salesforce Administrator | Work From Home | Full Time



We’re OpenCorp. For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped everyday Australians build wealth through property with the right strategy, advice and ongoing support.



We’re looking for an experienced Senior Salesforce Administrator to join our Technology Team. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can do more than administer Salesforce — you’ll work with stakeholders to understand business problems, design smart solutions and take them all the way from discovery through to delivery.



You’ll play a key role in how Salesforce supports our business, balancing day-to-day platform administration with solution design, project delivery, continuous improvement and mentoring other Salesforce Administrators.



What you’ll be doing:



- Owning day-to-day Salesforce administration, including users, permissions, security, reports, dashboards, data quality and platform health

- Managing and resolving Salesforce support requests while looking beyond the immediate issue to identify opportunities for improvement

- Working directly with stakeholders to understand business problems, processes and desired outcomes

- Leading discovery sessions and translating business requirements into practical Salesforce solutions

- Designing and building scalable solutions using Salesforce Flow, validation rules, formulas, approvals, custom objects and other declarative tools

- Managing Salesforce projects from discovery and solution design through build, testing, UAT, deployment and post-release support

- Reviewing Salesforce solutions developed by other team members to ensure quality, maintainability and consistency

- Helping strengthen our Salesforce DevOps and release-management practices

- Supporting integrations, APIs, data migrations and other connected business platforms

- Creating clear solution, technical, process and user documentation

- Mentoring Salesforce Administrators and sharing knowledge across the Technology Team

- Continuously identifying ways Salesforce can reduce manual work, improve data quality and create a better user experience



We’re looking for someone with

- At least 4 years of demonstrated Salesforce experience, including senior administration or consulting responsibilities

- Salesforce Certified Administrator certification

- Salesforce Platform App Builder certification or equivalent demonstrated capability

- Advanced hands-on experience with Salesforce Flow and declarative automation

- Proven experience taking Salesforce projects from discovery and requirements through build, UAT and deployment

- Experience working directly with business stakeholders and confidently leading solution discussions

- Practical experience with Salesforce DevOps, source control, structured deployments or release-management tools

- Experience conducting peer reviews and applying Salesforce development standards

- Experience supporting integrations, data migrations or connected business systems

- Strong problem-solving skills with the confidence to challenge a request and understand the real business problem before building a solution

- Excellent written and spoken English with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders

- A strong focus on quality, documentation, scalability and long-term maintainability



Highly regarded

- Salesforce Advanced Administrator, Business Analyst or Sales Cloud Consultant certification

- Experience with Gearset, Copado, Flosum, Salesforce DevOps Center or similar tools

- Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, outbound messages or native Salesforce integrations

- Experience with Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot), Sales Engagement, Experience Cloud, Agentforce or Data Cloud

- Experience mentoring Salesforce Administrators or helping improve technical standards across a team

- Experience working remotely with Australian, UK or US stakeholders

- Exposure to Agile delivery, Jira and Confluence



About you

title: Customer Support Specialist - Shopify Lighting Store (Email + Fulfillment Coordination)
description:
About us



STORE is a European online store selling designer lighting - chandeliers, wall lamps, table lamps and pendants - to customers in the UK, Ireland, the US, Canada, Australia and across Europe. Orders run through Shopify and are shipped by our fulfillment partners in Asia. Customer mail runs through one shared support mailbox.



The role



You are the voice of the store. You own the support inbox from the first message to the closed ticket, and you keep our fulfillment partners moving so that the answers we give customers are actually true.



What you will do every day:



- Answer customer
: order status, delivery times, product questions, order changes, returns, refunds and delivery complaints.

- Look up orders, customers, tracking and fulfillment status in Shopify.

- Write to our fulfillment partners (WhatsApp, Slack and their own platforms) to chase quotes, stock, tracking numbers and shipment problems, then bring the answer back to the customer.

- Keep a clear view of every open ticket: what waits on us, what waits on a partner, what waits on the customer. Nothing sits untouched.

- Follow our written playbook for refunds, returns, damaged goods and delivery delays. Anything the playbook does not cover comes to me before it goes to the customer.

- Flag patterns. If five people ask the same question, we fix the product page.



What we need from you



- Real experience in ecommerce customer support over
. You have run a live ticket queue, not just answered the occasional message.

- Hands-on Shopify experience: orders, fulfillments, tracking, refunds, customer records.

- Experience dealing with suppliers or fulfillment partners, ideally in dropshipping or ecommerce logistics. You can push a supplier for an answer without being rude.

- Written English that reads as human and warm. Our customers are in Europe and North America and they are buying a piece for their home. Short sentences, plain words, no stiff corporate language, no copy-paste templates.

- Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for the
 work. You use them to draft faster and you correct every word before it goes out.

- Organised. You can hold thirty open threads without losing one.

- A reliable daily overlap with European business hours.



Nice to have



- Helpdesk tools, Slack and Google Sheets.

- A background in home goods, furniture or lighting.

- A second European language.



The details



- Full time, 40 hours per week

- 5 USD per hour, paid monthly

- Long term position. We train you on our playbook and our partners, and we want you to stay and grow with the store.



How to apply



We do not read CVs first. We read the test.



Take the desk test here: clerachic-desk-test.vercel.app/ (START HERE!)



Ten real cases from our support mailbox, names and order numbers changed, everything else as it happened. You read our desk rules first and keep them open while you work. About forty minutes. At the end your answers are sent with one click and you get a reference code.



Using Claude or ChatGPT during the test is allowed. You are responsible for every word.



Then send your OnlineJobs message with:



- your reference code from the test

- how many years you have done ecommerce
 support

- which Shopify tasks you have done yourself

- which AI tools you use in your daily work



No reference code, no reply. That is the whole filter.

title: Recruitment Delivery Manager — US Direct-Hire Staffing — Night Shift, Remote
description:
Type of Work: Full-time | Hours: 40/week | Shift: Fixed US night shift (~9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT), Mon–Fri

Compensation: $1,200–$2,000/month base + placement-linked bonus

Company: Talent Staffing and Recruiting — a US-based direct-hire staffing firm focused on healthcare/allied-health, expanding into new verticals



JOB OVERVIEW

We're hiring a Recruitment Delivery Manager — a player-coach who owns our open-job board end-to-end and is accountable for filling it. Fully remote, Philippines-based, reporting directly to the founder.



This is not a sourcing-team or coordinator seat. You take the list of open US jobs, build the fill strategy for each one (sourcing channels, candidate pool, pay-band reality, timeline), personally recruit on the priority searches — sourcing, screening, and submitting candidates yourself — and build and coach a small delivery team as volume grows. You own the number: qualified submittals per week and jobs filled.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Own the open-req board: triage every US job, build a written per-req fill strategy, and keep every req moving or call it honestly.

Personally work the priority desks full-cycle: source, screen (live phone/video), prep, and submit qualified candidates to US clients.

Drive the delivery standard — quality-gated submittals per recruiter per week — with every candidate recruiter-screened before submission, no resume-blasting.

Recruit, onboard, and coach delivery recruiters as the board requires; run the daily delivery cadence and report fill metrics weekly to the founder.

Tell the truth with numbers: pipeline, submittals, interviews, offers, fills — measured, never estimated.



REQUIRED



4+ years US staffing/recruiting delivery experience, including 2+ years leading a delivery team measured on submittals and placements (not a sourcing-only or admin team). US healthcare staffing strongly preferred; allied health/imaging a major plus.

Placements you personally closed — you can name specific placements you made (role, US state, salary) and walk through how you filled them. There will be a detailed walkthrough in the interview.

Tenure that holds: at least one 24+ month run at a single staffing employer.

Excellent spoken English — you'll screen candidates by phone and coach people who do; there's a live spoken check.

Fluent with an ATS and modern sourcing (job boards, LinkedIn, licensure/credential basics for US healthcare roles).

Can work the fixed US night shift long-term with a reliable home setup (quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup power/data).



Do NOT apply if:



Your leadership experience is sourcing/CV-mining teams only (you've never owned submittals-to-fill).

You've only coordinated VMS portals or onboarding paperwork.

You cannot name specific placements you personally closed.

Your spoken English isn't strong enough to screen US healthcare professionals, or you can't commit to the fixed US night shift.



Why us: You run the whole delivery engine, not a slice of it — direct line to the founder, real authority over strategy and (as volume grows) your own team, competitive base plus a placement-linked bonus so your fills pay you, fully remote, long-term.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



The delivery team you led: company, your title, team headcount, what the team was measured on, and its typical submittals + placements per month. What part did you personally still recruit on?

Name ONE placement you personally closed in the last 2 years — job title, US state, salary, and how you found the candidate. (Most important question — real specifics; we verify on the call.)

Your longest single tenure at one staffing employer: company + number of months.

A US client gives you a hard-to-fill job: CT Technologist in Colorado, 9 candidates already submitted by others, none hired. In 4–6 sentences: your fill strategy, step by step.

Can you commit to a fixed US night shift (~9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT), Mon–Fri, long-term? (Yes/No + any constraint) And your home setup: internet speed, headset, quiet room, backup power/internet?

Current/most-recent monthly pay (PHP or USD), earliest start date, and a 30–60 sec voice intro (link) introducing yourself as if opening a screening call with a US radiologic technologist.

description:
# Remote Chat Sales Setter / Lead Engagement Specialist



Elevated Recovery is hiring a highly organized, persuasive, and emotionally intelligent Chat Sales Setter to manage conversations with prospective clients across multiple platforms.



We help men overcome compulsive pornography use and related behaviors. This role requires maturity, discretion, empathy, and comfort discussing sensitive topics directly and professionally.



## What You’ll Do



* Manage multiple active conversations across SMS, email, social media, and our CRM

* Respond quickly while keeping every conversation personal and context-aware

* Ask thoughtful questions, identify needs, and guide qualified prospects toward booking a call

* Follow up consistently with new, old, and previously unresponsive leads

* Track large numbers of leads without losing conversations or missing next steps

* Keep CRM records, notes, statuses, and follow-up dates accurate

* Handle basic questions and objections through chat without sounding scripted

* Make outbound calls when necessary to reconnect with leads or confirm appointments

* Coordinate with the sales team to ensure clean handoffs and strong show rates



## You May Be a Strong Fit If You Are



* An excellent written communicator with natural, conversational English

* Experienced in chat sales, appointment setting, lead nurturing, or online sales

* Comfortable managing many conversations at once across different platforms

* Highly organized and attentive to small details

* Able to personalize templates rather than blindly copying and pasting them

* Persistent with follow-up without becoming pushy

* Comfortable making outbound calls when chat alone is not enough

* Coachable, adaptable, and able to implement feedback quickly

* Reliable during U.S. business hours and available for at least one weekend shift

* Comfortable discussing pornography, relationships, recovery, and other sensitive subjects professionally



## This Role Is Not a Fit If You



* Frequently miss messages or forget follow-ups

* Depend entirely on scripts and struggle to think within a live conversation

* Avoid phone calls

* Become overwhelmed when managing multiple platforms or a large lead pipeline

* Need constant supervision to keep CRM records organized

* Are uncomfortable discussing pornography and recovery directly



## Schedule and Compensation



* Full-time remote position

* Approximately 40 hours per week

* U.S. working hours, including at least one weekend day

* $5 USD per hour plus performance-based commissions

* Training, scripts, feedback, and ongoing sales development provided



## How to Apply



Begin your application with the words **“CHAT SETTER”** and include:



1. A brief description of your chat sales or appointment-setting experience.

2. The largest number of leads or active conversations you have managed.

3. The platforms and CRMs you have used.

4. Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time.

5. A one- to two-minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be effective in this role.



Then answer this sample lead message in your own words:



> “I’m interested, but I’m not ready to book a call. Can you just tell me how much it costs?”



We are looking closely at your ability to write naturally, ask good questions, stay organized, and move a conversation forward.

STR market

 groups

Real estate networks

STR communities

Your existing network

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for candidates with experience in:



Property acquisition

STR/Airbnb client acquisition

Property management sales

Real estate sales or business development

A closely related acquisition role

title: 📊 WORKFORCE ANALYST — CAN YOU KEEP 120 AGENTS IN THE RIGHT PLACE AT THE RIGHT TIME?
description:
**120 Phone Agents | 7-Day U.S. Operation | Forecasting + Scheduling + Real-Time Management**



Anyone can build a schedule.



We need someone who can build the **RIGHT schedule** — and then manage the operation when reality doesn’t follow the forecast.



Our targets are aggressive:



**📞 Abandon Rate: ≤3%**

**⏱️ AHT: 10 Minutes**

**🎯 Right People. Right Place. Right Time.**



If you live in spreadsheets, spot staffing problems before Operations feels them, and know exactly what to do when volume suddenly jumps...



**Keep reading.**



👋 ABOUT US



We’re ECX, a fast-growing, retention-first Customer Experience agency supporting leading health, wellness, and eCommerce brands.



We combine customer experience, retention, technology, and data to protect revenue and deliver exceptional customer experiences.



We’re looking for an **experienced Workforce Analyst** to own workforce planning and execution for approximately **120 phone agents** operating across a **7-day U.S. EST schedule — Sunday through Saturday.**



This is **not an entry-level WFM role.**



🎯 YOUR MISSION



Simple: **Have enough people available when our customers call — without overstaffing the operation.**



You’ll own the workforce puzzle from beginning to end:



**Forecast → Capacity → Schedule → Shifts → Lunches → Breaks → Intraday → Report → Adjust**



You should always know whether we are properly staffed **today, tomorrow, and in the weeks ahead.**



🔥 WHAT YOU’LL OWN



**Forecasting & Capacity Planning**

Forecast call volume, AHT, workload, shrinkage, and staffing requirements using historical data and business trends.



**Scheduling**

Build and optimize schedules for approximately **120 phone agents**, including shifts, lunches, breaks, days off, meetings, coaching, training, and other offline activities.



**Real-Time Management**

Monitor intraday volume, staffing, adherence, queues, SLA, and abandonment — and make adjustments before performance gets away from us.



**Staffing & Shrinkage**

Track occupancy, utilization, adherence, absenteeism, PTO, shrinkage, and staffing gaps while maintaining appropriate coverage.



**Reporting & Analytics**

Produce meaningful **daily, weekly, monthly, and comparative reporting** that shows more than what happened.



We want to know:



**Why did it happen? What is changing? What is at risk? What should Operations do next?**



**Operational Partnership**

Work closely with Operations, Training, QA, and leadership to plan hiring, nesting, coaching, meetings, and other offline activities without sacrificing service.



**Continuous Improvement**

Identify scheduling inefficiencies, forecasting gaps, unnecessary shrinkage, coverage problems, and opportunities to improve workforce utilization.



📈 WE LOVE DATA. YOU SHOULD TOO.



We are looking for someone who can take workforce data and turn it into a **story Operations can act on.**



Strong experience with at least one of the following is required:



**Power BI | Looker Studio | Advanced Excel/Google Sheets Reporting**



Your reporting should include dashboards, trends, comparisons, variances, and actionable insights — not just rows of numbers.



If Tuesday's abandon rate suddenly jumps from 2.5% to 7%, we don't want a report on Friday telling us it happened.



**We want you investigating it Tuesday.**



 🧠 EXPERIENCED WORKFORCE PROFESSIONALS ONLY



You should bring:



• **3–5+ years of dedicated Workforce Management experience** in a BPO/contact center

• Proven experience forecasting and scheduling a **large voice operation**

• Hands-on experience managing shifts, lunches, breaks, shrinkage, adherence, and intraday staffing

• Strong understanding of **SLA, abandon rate, AHT, occupancy, utilization, shrinkage, and schedule adherence**

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills — pivots, complex formulas, modeling, and dashboards

• Strong experience with WFM platforms such as NICE IEX, Verint, Calabrio, Aspect/Alvaria, or similar

• Strong Power BI, Looker Studio, or advanced spreadsheet reporting experience

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Ability to communicate workforce risks and recommendations confidently to Operations leadership



Most importantly, you must be **proactive.**



Don't wait for Operations to tell you we're understaffed.



**Tell Operations before they feel it.**



 🕐 THE OPERATION



**Remote — Philippines**

**Full-Time**

**U.S. EST Coverage**



Our contact center operates **Sunday through Saturday**, you work Monday - Friday and ensure we're good for the weekend.



Your assigned schedule will support business needs and may require weekends or adjusted hours based on operational requirements.



Reliable high-speed internet, a professional workspace, and **dual monitors are required.**



🚨 THINK YOU CAN SOLVE THE PUZZLE?



Don't tell us you're “good with Excel.”



**Show us.**



In your application, answer these three questions:



**1. What is the largest number of agents you've personally forecasted and scheduled for?**



**2. If tomorrow's forecast requires 85 agents but only 71 are scheduled, walk us through what you would do TODAY.**



**3. Your abandon rate hits 6% against a ≤3% target while AHT increases above 10 minutes. What data do you investigate first?**



PLEASE ALSO SUBMIT:



• Your updated resume

• A **1–2 minute video introduction** explaining your WFM experience

• Screenshot of your internet speed

• Photo of your dual-monitor workspace

• **A WFM report or dashboard YOU personally created**



Your sample must demonstrate reporting beyond basic spreadsheets. **Power BI, Looker Studio, or a detailed Excel/Google Sheets dashboard with trends and comparative analysis is required.**



Please remove any confidential employer/client information before submitting.



APPLICATION SUBJECT: **“RIGHT PEOPLE. RIGHT TIME. — [Your Name]”**



⚠️ **Applications without the required answers and work sample will not be considered.**



If you can forecast it, schedule it, monitor it, explain it — and adjust it before it becomes an Operations problem —



**we want to meet you. 📊**

title: Cold Caller
description:
We are looking for an experienced Cold Caller / Sales Representative to join our growing company.



This is not a basic appointment-setting role where you simply read a script and move on. We are looking for someone with real sales experience who is comfortable having conversations with business owners, handling objections, building interest, and confidently moving prospects to the next step.



You will be making outbound calls to business owners and introducing them to our services. Your ability to think on your feet and have a natural conversation is extremely important.



What You'll Be Doing



-Making outbound cold calls to business owners

-Starting conversations and building interest in our services

-Qualifying potential clients

-Handling objections confidently and professionally

-Following a proven sales script while being able to adapt naturally to the conversation

-Booking qualified appointments or helping move interested prospects through the sales process

-Updating call outcomes and notes



What We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who:

-Has previous cold calling and/or sales experience

-Has a proven ability to sell, not just read from a script

-Is confident handling objections such as "I'm not interested," "We already have something," "Send me some information," or It's too expensive"

-Can think quickly and keep a conversation going naturally

-Speaks extremely fluent English with clear pronunciation, natural conversational delivery, and strong grammar

-Can communicate comfortably and professionally with business owners in the United States

-Has a clear, professional phone presence that is easy for U.S.-based prospects to understand

-Is energetic, confident, and not afraid of rejection

-Is reliable and comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

-Has a good internet connection, quality microphone/headset, and a quiet workspace

-Important Application Requirement



To be considered, please include a voice recording with your application.

In the recording, please briefly introduce yourself and answer the following:

-Tell us about your previous cold calling or sales experience.

-Give an example of a difficult objection you have handled and how you responded.

-Pretend I am a business owner and give me a short example of how you would start a cold call.



We are paying close attention to your English fluency, clarity, communication skills, confidence, sales ability, and how naturally you handle a conversation.

Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



If you are an experienced salesperson who knows how to build rapport, overcome objections, and confidently sell over the phone, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior E-commerce Customer Experience Specialist | Shopify | Full-Time
description:
Senior E-commerce Customer Experience Specialist | Shopify | Full-Time



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines

US$9–$12/hour depending on experience and demonstrated ability



About Us



Inka Arthouse is a fast-growing international wall art brand operating across Australia, the United States, United Kingdom, New Zealand and Europe.



We're looking for an exceptionally capable Customer Experience Specialist to join our team full-time and long-term.



This is not an entry-level VA or basic scripted customer service position.



We're looking for someone who understands instructions quickly, retains what they've learned, uses strong judgment and can solve problems independently.



You won't be expected to know everything on day one. What matters is that when you're taught something, you understand the reasoning behind it, remember it and can apply that knowledge correctly to future situations.



What You'll Do



You'll handle customer enquiries including:



Order and delivery enquiries

Tracking and courier issues

Damaged orders

Replacements and refunds

Incorrect orders

Address changes

Product questions

Complaints and escalations

Shopify order management

Communicating with our warehouse and operations teams



Our goal isn't simply to answer tickets quickly.



We want customers to receive fast, thoughtful and genuinely helpful solutions, while making sensible decisions for the business.



What We're Looking For



Essential:



2+ years of e-commerce customer service experience

Excellent written English

Excellent comprehension and attention to detail

Strong ability to retain new information and processes

Strong problem-solving skills and independent judgment

Experience using Shopify

Experience handling refunds, replacements, shipping issues and unhappy customers

Ability to understand the reasoning behind a process rather than simply following a script

Ability to recognise when information is missing and ask the right questions

Comfortable learning new systems and processes quickly

Reliable internet and a professional home working environment



Experience with Gorgias, Zendesk, ShipStation or similar platforms is highly regarded.



Experience supporting Australian, US or UK e-commerce customers is also highly regarded.



AI Experience



We use modern tools and technology throughout our business, so you should be comfortable working with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or similar platforms.



We're looking for someone who can use AI intelligently to improve speed and quality, while still thinking independently.



You should be able to:



Use AI to assist with drafting and improving customer responses

Check facts and customer context before relying on an AI-generated response

Recognise when an AI response is incorrect, incomplete or doesn't make sense

Adjust responses to suit the actual customer and situation

Never blindly copy and send an AI-generated response



AI can help you work faster, but it should never replace your own understanding and judgment.



The Type of Person We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is sharp, reliable, curious and takes ownership.



If you're given a new instruction, you should be able to understand it, retain it and apply it again later.



If you encounter a situation you haven't seen before, we want you to think about what you already know and work out the most sensible solution.



If something doesn't make sense, we want you to recognise that and ask the right question rather than guess.



You should be comfortable making decisions within the processes you've been taught rather than needing every possible situation explained individually.



We're looking for someone who can become a trusted member of the team and handle customer situations independently without needing constant supervision.



Compensation



US$9–$12 per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



We're willing to pay at the top of the range for someone who demonstrates exceptional comprehension, judgment, communication and e-commerce experience.



This is a full-time, long-term position.



How to Apply



Please answer all six questions below in your own words.



1. Previous experience



Which e-commerce companies have you previously worked for?



Please tell us:



What the company sold

Your position

How long you worked there

Your main responsibilities

2. Systems



Which platforms have you personally used?



Please explain your experience with Shopify, Gorgias, Zendesk, Tidio or any similar systems.



3. Ticket volume



Approximately how many customer enquiries or tickets did you personally handle per day in your most recent customer service position?



4. Problem solving



Tell us about a difficult customer situation where there wasn't an obvious solution.



What happened, what did you d
 to do, and why did you make that decision?



5. Customer scenario



A customer ordered three framed prints.



Their order arrives and one frame has been damaged during delivery. The artwork inside the damaged frame is completely fine. The other two framed prints are also perfect.



The customer contacts you and asks you to send them three completely new framed prints.



What would you do, and why?



There isn't a specific script we're looking for. We're interested in how you think through the situation.



6. AI



Tell us how you've used Claude, ChatGPT or another AI tool in a previous customer service or e-commerce role.



If AI drafts a customer response for you, what do you personally check before sending it?



Important Application Instructions



Please write your application answers yourself.



Do not use ChatGPT, Claude or another AI tool to generate your application answers. We're specifically interested in seeing your natural written communication and how you personally think through problems.



Start your application with the words:



BLUE FRAME



Applications that don't follow this instruction may not be considered.



What Happens Next



We're taking this hire seriously and won't be selecting someone based purely on their CV or interview.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practical assessment involving realistic e-commerce customer service situations.



The assessment will look at:



Comprehension

Problem solving

Attention to detail

Written communication

Ability to retain new information

Independent judgment

Ability to apply previously provided information to new situations



Successful candidates will then have a short interview before we make our final decision.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of Inka Arthouse, take ownership of their work and grow with the business.

title: Ecommerce Operations & Customer Support Specialist
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based ecommerce company looking for a reliable, detail-oriented person to join our team long-term.



This role involves **ecommerce operations, customer support, and working with company-provided software and AI-assisted tools.**



We already have a simple, established system in place. You will receive training and a clear daily workflow to follow.



This is **not a highly technical position**, and you do not need to be an advanced graphic designer. We are primarily looking for someone who learns quickly, communicates well, follows instructions, has strong attention to detail, and is friendly and helpful with customers.



# Long-Term Growth Opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of our team.



Our company is continuing to grow, and for the right person there will be opportunities to:



* Take on more responsibility

* Learn additional parts of the business

* Move into a larger operations role

* Earn increased pay over time



We value dependable team members and want someone who is interested in growing with the company rather than simply working a short-term position.



# Work Schedule



This position is approximately **30 hours per week — 6 hours per day, Monday through Friday.**



The 6 hours are divided into **two 3-hour shifts each day**.



All scheduling is based on **U.S. Central Time (CT).**



You may select:



* **Any 3 consecutive hours between 5:00 AM and 12:00 PM Central Time**

* **Any 3 consecutive hours between 5:00 PM and 12:00 AM Central Time**



For applicants in the Philippines, these windows are currently approximately:



* U.S. morning window = **6:00 PM–1:00 AM Philippine Time**

* U.S. evening window = **6:00 AM–1:00 PM Philippine Time the following day**



The Philippine equivalent may shift by one hour when U.S. daylight saving time changes.



You will choose a consistent 3-hour shift within each window.



**You must be available for both a morning and evening U.S. Central Time shift.**



# What You’ll Be Doing



Most tasks are straightforward and repeatable. We already have systems, software, and step-by-step procedures in place.



Your daily work will mainly involve:



* Checking new customer orders

* Checking and responding to customer messages

* Providing friendly and professional customer service

* Following our internal order-processing system

* Using company-provided software and AI-assisted tools

* Preparing customer-facing order previews and materials

* Reviewing layouts for proper positioning and overall appearance

* Handling basic customer revisions and updates

* Following up with customers when necessary

* Updating order statuses

* Moving approved orders forward through our system

* Keeping internal records organized

* Completing general ecommerce operational tasks

* Following a simple daily checklist



You will not be expected to create your own process. We already have an established workflow that you will be trained to follow.



# What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



* Very detail-oriented

* Reliable and consistent

* Friendly, patient, and helpful with customers

* Strong in written English

* Familiar with ecommerce

* Comfortable using AI tools

* Comfortable learning new software

* Able to follow step-by-step procedures

* Organized and able to manage multiple orders

* Able to work independently after training

* Able to recognize when something looks visually incorrect, off-center, unbalanced, too large, or too small

* Professional when handling customer questions or revisions



Good visual judgment is important, but **advanced graphic-design experience is not required.**



## Helpful Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* Shopify

* Ecommerce operations

* Customer support

* Order management

* Custom-product businesses

* Graphic or image-editing software

* AI tools

* Customer proofing or approval workflows



# Technology & AI



AI and technology will be part of your normal work.



You should be comfortable:



* Using AI tools

* Learning new software

* Following structured digital workflows

* Reviewing computer-generated outputs

* Recognizing when something does not look correct

* Making adjustments when necessary



All required company systems and procedures will be taught during training.



# Customer Support



Part of your role will involve communicating directly with customers.



This may include:



* Answering order-related questions

* Sending customer updates

* Handling basic revision requests

* Following up with customers

* Explaining information clearly and patiently

* Resolving basic issues in a helpful and professional manner



Strong written English, a friendly personality, and a genuine desire to help customers are important.



# Who Will Do Well Here?



You will likely be a strong fit if you:



* Notice small mistakes

* Learn software quickly

* Like organized and repeatable systems

* Are comfortable using AI

* Enjoy ecommerce

* Communicate clearly and kindly

* Follow instructions carefully

* Stay calm and professional with customers

* Take ownership of your work

* Can recognize whether something looks clean, centered, and professional



# How To Apply



Please answer **all** of the following:



1. Tell us about your previous ecommerce experience.

2. Which ecommerce platforms have you worked with?

3. Tell us about your customer-support experience.

4. How comfortable are you using AI tools?

5. What design or image-editing software have you used?

6. Have you worked for a custom-product or order-based ecommerce company before?

7. Which **3-hour morning CT shift** would you prefer?

8. Which **3-hour evening CT shift** would you prefer?

9. What is your desired weekly or monthly salary?

10. Tell us about a previous position where attention to detail was important.



**IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words “ECOM OPS.”



Applications that do not include this will not be considered.



We are looking for someone dependable, friendly, and customer-focused who wants a stable, long-term position with real opportunity for growth, increased responsibility, and higher pay over time.

title: High-Ticket Account Manager | US Clients - $1,500–$2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Independent Medical Administrative Service Provider
description:
Zocdoc, Intake, Scheduling & eCW/EHR Support

Company: Exxceed Wellness, doing business as Aurevia Health Solutions

Engagement type: Independent Service Provider / Contractor

Location: Philippines — remote work from a private, secure home office

Openings: 2

Start: IMMEDIATELY



Compensation: **US$28 per accepted 8-hour Service Block** (equivalent to US$3.50 per service-block hour), plus possible additional fees for approved defined work packages.

Potential earnings: **Up to US$840 in a 30-day month** when 30 Service Blocks are offered, accepted, and completed at the standard US$28 rate.



Important: This is an independent-contractor engagement with Exxceed Wellness d/b/a Aurevia Health Solutions, not employment. Service Blocks are offered based on client demand and business needs; no minimum number of Service Blocks, hours, or monthly income is guaranteed.



About Exxceed Wellness d/b/a Aurevia Health Solutions

Exxceed Wellness, doing business as Aurevia Health Solutions (“Aurevia”) provides shared, nonclinical administrative support to U.S. healthcare practices. We help with Zocdoc booking workflows, intake coordination, scheduling administration, insurance-information collection and verification support, and authorized administrative data entry in eClinicalWorks (eCW) and other approved systems.

We are building a small, privacy-first contractor network and are looking for two dependable, long-term independent medical administrative service providers. This is an opportunity for experienced healthcare VAs who want recurring, flexible work opportunities while supporting U.S. practices with accurate, timely, secure administrative services.



Why Apply

• Earn US$28 for each accepted and completed 8-hour Service Block.

• Potential to earn up to US$840 in a 30-day month at 30 accepted and completed standard Service Blocks.

• Opportunity to receive recurring Service Block offers as Aurevia’s client demand grows.

• Work remotely from your private home office.

• Choose whether to accept future offered Service Blocks.

• Build experience with U.S. medical-administration workflows, including Zocdoc, patient intake, scheduling, insurance administration, and authorized eCW/EHR work.

• Work with a small operations team that values accuracy, privacy, communication, secure handoffs, and long-term professional relationships.

Illustrative earning potential — not a guarantee

Accepted and completed Service Blocks in a 30-day month Standard fee per Service Block Illustrative total

10 US$28 US$280

15 US$28 US$420

20 US$28 US$560

26 US$28 US$728

30 US$28 **US$840**



Actual offered blocks and earnings depend on client demand, business needs, your submitted availability, your decision to accept offered Work Orders, successful completion of accepted Work Orders, quality, privacy/security compliance, and continued access authorization. The examples above are illustrations only and are not a promise of future work, minimum income, or employment.



What You Will Do

When you voluntarily accept a Service Block Work Order from Exxceed Wellness d/b/a Aurevia Health Solutions, you may be asked to perform authorized, nonclinical tasks such as:

• Monitor an approved Zocdoc booking queue and booking notifications.

• Review new bookings, cancellations, reschedules, and patient-provided administrative information.

• Process clearly eligible administrative booking items using written practice rules.

• Send client-approved intake forms, consent forms, patient instructions, and insurance-card requests through approved systems.

• Search for an existing patient record and help prevent duplicate charts using the approved workflow.

• Create or update permitted demographic, contact, guarantor/subscriber, insurance, appointment, intake-status, and document-indexing fields in eCW/EHR systems.

• Reconcile Zocdoc booking information with approved EHR or scheduling calendars.

• Upload and index approved administrative documents, such as photo IDs, insurance cards, signed forms, referrals, authorizations, and intake documents.

• Perform insurance eligibility/benefits administrative tasks only when authorized in the Work Order and client workflow.

• Record actions, task status, pending items, deadlines, and next steps in the secure task queue.

• Escalate incomplete information, duplicate-chart risks, schedule conflicts, safety messages, clinical questions, and other exceptions under the written workflow.

• Complete a secure task handoff at the end of an accepted Service Block when required.

What You Will Never Do

This is a strictly nonclinical administrative role. You will not:

• Give medical, mental-health, medication, diagnostic, treatment, or insurance-coverage advice.

• Perform clinical triage, counseling, crisis intervention, emergency response, or 911/988 monitoring.

• Write, edit, sign, attest to, or authenticate clinical notes, diagnoses, treatment plans, progress notes, or psychotherapy notes.

• Select or change ICD-10, CPT, modifiers, billing codes, diagnoses, medications, allergies, orders, or clinical documentation.

• Use a clinician’s password, MFA code, electronic signature, or other credentials.

• Make independent clinical acceptance/rejection decisions.

Service-Block Model

This engagement with Exxceed Wellness d/b/a Aurevia Health Solutions is based on discrete Service Block Work Orders, not a permanent employee schedule.

• Exxceed Wellness d/b/a Aurevia Health Solutions may offer available 8-hour Service Blocks or defined work packages in advance.

• We are seeking providers interested in recurring opportunities and building a long-term professional relationship as client demand grows.

• You may accept or decline future offered Service Blocks in your discretion.

• If a Service Block is offered, accepted, and completed at the standard rate, the fee is US$28 unless the Work Order states a different rate.

• If you accept a block, you must meet the agreed nonclinical scope, response standards, security requirements, and secure-handoff requirements for that accepted block.

• Sample availability may include coverage blocks aligned to 8:00 a.m.–12:00 midnight Pacific Time, including weekends. This does not require you to accept any future block.

• You may work with other clients, provided there is no conflict of interest and you protect all confidential information.

• Exxceed Wellness d/b/a Aurevia Health Solutions maintains backup continuity coverage for blocks that are not accepted or need to be transferred.

• There is no guaranteed minimum number of Service Blocks, hours, payments, or monthly income.

Required Qualifications

Please apply only if you meet all of the following requirements:

• At least 2 years of recent experience in U.S. healthcare administration, medical virtual assistance, medical scheduling, patient intake, EHR support, insurance verification, or a closely related role.

• Strong written and spoken English, with clear, professional, empathetic communication.

• Demonstrated accuracy, attention to detail, organization, and ability to follow written workflows exactly.

• Experience with at least one EHR, EMR, practice-management, scheduling, patient-intake, or medical CRM system.

• Comfortable handling patient demographic information, appointment data, insurance-card information, and administrative healthcare documents with care and confidentiality.

• Willingness and ability to complete HIPAA/privacy/security training before receiving access.

• Comfortable working only within nonclinical administrative boundaries and escalating clinical, safety, and exception items immediately.

• A private, quiet, secure home-office setup where no unauthorized person can see, hear, or access patient/client information.

• A reliable computer suitable for secure remote work, updated operating system, current anti-malware protection, screen lock, and ability to use MFA.

• Reliable primary internet plus a realistic backup connection or contingency plan.

• Ability to issue a compliant invoice and manage your own tax and independent-contractor obligations in the Philippines.

• Willingness to sign Exxceed Wellness d/b/a Aurevia Health Solutions’ Independent Service Provider Agreement, confidentiality agreement, privacy/HIPAA subcontractor addendum, security attestation, and individual work orders.

Preferred Qualifications

These are preferred, but not mandatory:

• Hands-on eClinicalWorks (eCW) experience.

• Experience with Zocdoc, patient portals, telehealth administrative setup, payer portals, or U.S. behavioral-health/mental-health practices.

• Experience with U.S. insurance eligibility and benefits verification, prior-authorization tracking, referrals, or intake-document management.

• Previous HIPAA training or experience working for a U.S. covered entity or business associate.

• Experience with secure task queues, SOPs, quality checks, documentation, and remote handoffs.

• Experience supporting California-based practices or working with Pacific Time service commitments.

Security and Privacy Requirements

Because this role may involve U.S. protected health information (PHI), strict privacy and security are essential. You must be willing to:

• Use your own unique system credentials and MFA; never share passwords, MFA codes, or client access.

• Use only Exxceed Wellness d/b/a Aurevia Health Solutions-approved or client-approved systems and communication channels.

• Work only from a private, secure location; do not work from public places or shared computers.

• Never download, print, screenshot, photograph, screen-record, or store patient information outside approved systems.

• Never use personal
, personal messaging, personal cloud storage, USB drives, or unapproved AI/chatbot tools with patient or client information.

• Report a suspected privacy, security, phishing, credential, device, or data i
 immediately.

• Allow only you—not family, friends, roommates, or coworkers—to view or handle patient/client information.

How We Evaluate Candidates



Exxceed Wellness d/b/a Aurevia Health Solutions will assess:

• Medical-administrative experience and systems familiarity.

• Accuracy with patient-identifying details, appointment details, insurance information, and documents.

• Written-English clarity and professional communication.

• Ability to distinguish administrative work from clinical decisions and escalate appropriately.

• Privacy/security judgment and home-office readiness.

• Reliability in completing an accepted work order, documenting tasks, and performing secure handoffs.

• Ability to follow detailed SOPs without making assumptions.



Application Instructions



To apply, please send all of the following. Incomplete applications may not be reviewed.

1. Your resume/CV, including U.S. healthcare, medical VA, EHR, scheduling, intake, and insurance-related experience.

2. A short cover letter of no more than 250 words explaining:

o Your most relevant U.S. medical-administrative experience.

o Which EHR/EMR or practice-management systems you have used.

o Why you are comfortable with a nonclinical, privacy-sensitive contractor engagement with Exxceed Wellness d/b/a Aurevia Health Solutions.

3. Your current and expected per-service-block or per-deliverable contractor rate. Do not provide a monthly salary expectation.

4. Your weekly availability in Pacific Time, including whether you are open to weekday and/or weekend service blocks. Please note: sharing availability does not create an obligation to accept future blocks.

5. A list of your device specifications: computer type, processor, RAM, operating system, anti-malware tool, and whether full-disk encryption is enabled.

6. Your primary internet speed test result, backup internet/contingency plan, and confirmation that you work from a private, secure space.

7. A 60–90 second video introduction in English. Briefly explain your medical-administrative experience, how you protect patient information at home, and how you would handle a message asking for medication advice.

8. Include the phrase “AUREVIA SECURE ADMIN” as the first line of your application so we know you read the full posting.

Screening Process



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete:



1. A video interview/ A privacy/security and nonclinical-boundaries interview.

2. Google Workspace Skills Exam. A short, de-identified administrative-workflow assessment.

3. A device and secure-workspace verification.

4. Reference and identity verification, where legally permitted.

5. Contract, privacy/security, and onboarding review before system access is granted.

Do not send any real patient information, screenshots from prior healthcare jobs, passwords, or confidential client documents during your application.



Equal Opportunity

Exxceed Wellness d/b/a Aurevia Health Solutions evaluates candidates based on relevant experience, skills, communication, security readiness, reliability, and ability to perform the authorized nonclinical services. We welcome qualified applicants who can meet the role’s legitimate requirements.

title: Video Editor - Direct Response Ads - Ecommerce
description:
PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING:



We’re looking for a full-time Video Editor to join our creative team and produce high-performing direct-response video ads for Meta/Facebook and Instagram.



This is not a traditional video editing position.



We are not looking for someone who simply knows Premiere Pro, CapCut, or After Effects.



We are looking for an editor who understands advertising psychology, viewer retention, pacing, visual storytelling, and performance creative.



You need to understand how to take a script and turn it into an advertisement that keeps someone watching long enough to eventually purchase.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



You will receive scripts, hooks, creative direction, product assets, customer research, and reference advertisements.



Your job is to turn those materials into finished direct-response advertisements.



You should understand:



What type of footage belongs in each section of a script

How visuals should reinforce what the voiceover is saying

When a visual should demonstrate the problem

When a visual should demonstrate the desired outcome

When product footage should appear

When customer-style footage is more effective than polished brand footage

How long each clip should remain on screen

When visual changes are necessary to prevent attention from dropping

How to create pattern interrupts without making the advertisement chaotic

How to visually build curiosity

How to maintain momentum through longer advertisements

How to use subtitles, text overlays, screenshots, reviews, graphics, zooms, crops, transitions, and sound effects appropriately

How to make a 2–3 minute advertisement continue feeling engaging throughout



We do not want editors who simply place random stock footage over a voiceover.



Every clip should have a reason for being there.



This Is Performance Creative



Our advertisements are not created randomly.



Each script and creative batch is developed around specific variables such as:



Customer avatar

Market awareness level

Market sophistication

Specific customer problem

Core desire

Advertising angle

Hook

Unique mechanism

Customer objections

Proof

Emotional journey

Creative format

Specific variable being tested



As the editor, you need to understand the strategy behind the script so the visuals support it properly.



For example, if a section of the script is designed to create skepticism, curiosity, authority, urgency, or emotional tension, the footage and editing should reinforce that purpose.



You should be able to read a script and understand:



What is the viewer supposed to feel here?



What does the viewer need to see here?



What visual would make this claim more believable?



Where is attention likely to drop?



Do we need a visual change here?



Is this clip helping the story or simply filling space?



That judgment is extremely important to us.



Hooks Are Extremely Important



The first few seconds of an advertisement can determine whether the rest of the video ever gets watched.



You will regularly receive one main script with multiple hook variations.



You should understand how to make each hook feel visually distinct and compelling while transitioning naturally into the same main body of the advertisement.



We expect strong judgment around:



Opening visuals

First-frame selection

Pattern interrupts

Text placement

Curiosity

Pacing

Visual juxtaposition

Product reveals

Problem demonstrations

Emotional reactions

Authority

Results-focused openings



A weak opening can ruin an otherwise strong advertisement.



PERFORMANCE EXPERIENCE IS STRONGLY PREFERRED



We are primarily interested in editors who have previous experience producing direct-response advertisements that actually generated sales.



If you have worked on ads that scaled significantly, we want to see them.



Preference will be given to applicants who can show advertisements they personally edited that achieved:



$10,000+ in ad spend while maintaining a 2.0+ ROAS.



If you have this experience, include proof showing:



The advertisement

Spend

ROAS

Revenue or purchase performance

Relevant date range



You should also clearly explain what part of the creative you were responsible for.



If you have edited high-spend winning ads, that carries significantly more weight with us than a traditional editing reel.



What You'll Be Editing



The majority of the work will consist of direct-response social advertisements, including formats such as:



UGC-style ads

Founder/customer stories

Testimonial ads

Problem/solution ads

Advertorial-style videos

Authority-based ads

Demonstration ads

Comparison ads

Story-driven advertisements

Native-style social ads

Longer 2–3 minute direct-response ads

Shorter hook variations

Iterations of existing winning advertisements



Not every advertisement needs to look highly produced.



Sometimes the strongest creative may intentionally look like an organic phone video, customer testimonial, news clip, podcast, interview, slideshow, or social post.



You need to understand the difference between good editing and over-editing.



Finding Footage



You will not always be given every clip needed for an advertisement.



You should be comfortable sourcing or creating appropriate supporting visuals using:



Our branded footage

Stock footage

Customer-style footage

AI-generated images

AI-generated video

Screenshots

Reviews

Social media-style content

Product footage

Graphics

Other relevant assets



You should be resourceful.



If the script talks about something specific, we expect you to figure out what the viewer should see during that section rather than requiring us to select every individual clip for you.



AI Tools



Experience with AI creative tools is highly valuable.



This may include:



ChatGPT

Sora

Higgsfield

Veo

Kling

Runway

Midjourney

Gemini / Nano Banana

ElevenLabs

Other AI image/video generation tools



You do not need to use every tool listed.



We care about your ability to use modern tools to make better advertisements and solve creative problems quickly.



Editing Software



You may use whichever professional editing software allows you to produce the best work, including:



Adobe Premiere Pro

After Effects

DaVinci Resolve

CapCut

Final Cut Pro

Other professional editing software



The software itself does not matter.



The quality of the final advertisement does.



What We're Looking For



You should have:



Strong direct-response video editing experience

Strong understanding of Meta/Facebook advertising

Excellent sense of pacing

Strong visual storytelling instincts

Understanding of viewer retention

Ability to identify strong supporting footage

Strong judgment around clip duration

Understanding of hooks and pattern interrupts

Strong subtitle and text-overlay design

Good sound design

Strong attention to detail

Ability to follow scripts accurately

Ability to follow creative briefs

Ability to replicate the general editing principles of reference advertisements without simply copying them

Ability to work independently

Fast turnaround times

Reliable communication

Ability to take feedback and implement it correctly

Ability to produce a consistent volume of advertisements every week



Experience editing for DTC/e-commerce brands spending significant amounts on Meta advertising is strongly preferred.



What We Do NOT Want



Please do not apply if your editing process is essentially:



Add voiceover

Add random stock clips

Add captions

Add music

Export



That is not what we consider direct-response editing.



We need someone who thinks about the advertisement scene by scene and understands why each visual is being shown.



Attention to Detail Matters



Before delivering an advertisement, you should be checking:



Spelling

Subtitle accuracy

Audio levels

Music levels

Voice clarity

Clip resolution

Aspect ratio

Visual consistency

Awkward cuts

Repetitive footage

Unnecessary dead time

Branding

Product accuracy

Transitions

Overall pacing



The video should arrive ready to run as a paid advertisement.



Position



Full-Time / Long-Term



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of our creative team.



We continuously produce and test new advertisements, hooks, creative formats, stories, concepts, and iterations.



Editors who demonstrate strong creative judgment and consistently contribute to winning advertisements will have significant room to grow with us.



How To Apply



Your application should include:



Your video editing portfolio

At least 3 direct-response advertisements you personally edited

Your best-performing advertisements, if available

Any proof of advertisements you edited reaching $10,000+ in spend at a 2.0+ ROAS

A brief explanation of what YOU were responsible for on those advertisements

The editing software you use

The AI tools you currently use

Your experience editing Meta/Facebook advertisements



Please prioritize actual advertisements over cinematic reels, music videos, or traditional corporate editing examples.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid trial advertisement.



The trial will be used to evaluate your editing quality, visual judgment, pacing, ability to choose appropriate footage, ability to follow direction, attention to detail, and turnaround time.

You will work primarily with Actors’ Door, our private TV and Film acting academy, while gradually becoming involved with operations at Trillion Management.

We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted member of our operation, understands accountability, loves organization, and takes pride in keeping the business running smoothly.



YOUR PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



You will help oversee the administrative and financial operations of Actors’ Door.



Responsibilities will include:

• Maintaining professional Excel and Google Sheets reporting



• Managing company
 and administrative communications



• Organizing Google Workspace, calendars, documents, and internal records



• Assisting with administrative projects for Trillion Management as your responsibilities grow



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



We want someone who knows what is happening inside the business without waiting to be asked.



At the beginning of each month, you should know:



How many students are active.

Who has paid.

Who has not paid.

Which payments failed.

How much revenue was expected.

How much was collected.

How much remains outstanding.



During the week, you should know:



Which students are scheduled.

Which coaches are working.

Whether anyone needs coverage.

Which sessions were completed.

Which sessions require make-ups.

Which parents require communication.



Organization and follow-through are extremely important in this position.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should be:



• Extremely organized and detail-oriented



• Strong with Excel and Google Sheets



• Comfortable working with numbers and bookkeeping



• Experienced with administrative operations



• Excellent in written English



• Professional communicating with American parents, clients, and team members



• Comfortable following up professionally regarding outstanding payments



• Confident handling scheduling problems



• Comfortable making decisions within established company procedures



• Reliable with deadlines



• Comfortable handling confidential client and financial information



• Able to work independently after training



• Interested in building a long-term career with growing companies



Experience with bookkeeping, QuickBooks, Stripe, Excel, Outlook, Google Sheets, Google Workspace, scheduling, customer service, accounts receivable, or administrative operations is strongly preferred.



Entertainment industry experience is not required.



An interest in television, film, acting, Broadway, talent management, or the entertainment industry is a strong plus.



For someone interested in entertainment, this position offers exposure to the business side of professional talent management, including how actors move from training into professional representation and careers in television, film, voiceover, commercials, and Broadway.



HOURS



Approximately 20 to 25 hours per week to start with room to grow more.



We operate on New York Eastern Time.



Some availability during U.S. afternoon and evening hours is important because Actors’ Door coaching sessions primarily occur after school hours.



There is significant opportunity for increased responsibilities, hours, and compensation based on performance.



COMPENSATION



Starting compensation is approximately $5 USD per hour.



We will review performance and compensation after the initial training period.



Our goal is to find someone interested in building a long-term relationship with our companies rather than completing short-term freelance work.



HOW TO APPLY
