title: Finance & Business Development Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a highly organised, commercially minded and financially capable Business Development and Finance Officer to join our growing property and investment business.



This is a broad, hands-on position combining finance, accounting support, business development, property administration and general business operations.



The successful candidate will work closely with management and will be involved in the day-to-day financial running of the business, while also helping identify and progress new business, property and investment opportunities.



We are looking for someone who is proactive and capable of taking ownership of their responsibilities rather than waiting to be given instructions for every task.



Key Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include:



* Managing day-to-day financial administration and maintaining accurate financial records

* Recording and monitoring income, expenditure, invoices and payments

* Maintaining financial spreadsheets and internal management records

* Assisting with bookkeeping and preparing information for accountants

* Monitoring cash flow, upcoming payments and financial commitments

* Assisting management with budgets, financial information and reports

* Supporting mortgage, bridging finance, refinancing and other funding applications

* Preparing and organising documents required by lenders and finance providers

* Liaising with mortgage brokers, lenders, banks, accountants and financial professionals

* Liaising with solicitors, estate agents, valuers and other property professionals

* Following up outstanding finance, legal and property matters

* Maintaining organised records for properties, companies, finance facilities and transactions

* Monitoring important dates, renewals, payments and deadlines

* Researching potential property acquisitions and investment opportunities

* Carrying out initial financial assessments of potential opportunities

* Assisting with the progression of property purchases, refinancing and other transactions

* Researching potential lenders, finance products and business opportunities

* Supporting the development of new business projects and income streams

* Communicating with external companies and professional advisers on behalf of the business

* Preparing reports, documents, spreadsheets and information for management

* Helping improve internal systems and administrative processes

* Supporting general business operations where required



The role will develop as the company grows, so the successful candidate should be comfortable working across different areas of the business.



Qualifications & Experience



We would ideally like candidates to have one or more of the following:



* Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics or a related subject

* AAT qualification or currently studying towards AAT

* Part-qualified ACCA, CIMA or similar professional qualification

* Previous experience within finance, accounting, banking, mortgages or financial administration

* Previous experience within property, real estate, mortgages or investment would be advantageous



You do not need to be a fully qualified accountant.



We are particularly interested in candidates who have a good financial understanding and are interested in developing broader commercial and business experience.



Skills Required



The successful candidate should have:



* Strong numerical ability

* Good understanding of basic accounting and financial principles

* Strong Microsoft Excel skills

* Good general IT and computer skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Strong organisational and time-management skills

* Good written and verbal communication

* Ability to communicate professionally with banks, brokers, accountants, solicitors and other external professionals

* Ability to manage several tasks and deadlines at the same time

* Ability to work independently and use initiative

* Strong research and problem-solving skills

* Commercial awareness

* A professional and confidential approach when dealing with financial information



Personal Qualities



We are looking for someone who is:



* Proactive and self-motivated

* Reliable and organised

* Ambitious and willing to learn

* Commercially minded

* Confident taking responsibility

* Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment

* Able to identify problems and suggest solutions

* Interested in property, finance, investment and business growth

* Looking for a position where they can develop and take on greater responsibility over time



Why Work With Us?



This is not a narrow finance or administration position.



You will have the opportunity to work directly with decision-makers and gain practical experience across finance, property investment, acquisitions, refinancing and business development.



As the business continues to grow, there will be opportunities for the successful candidate to expand their responsibilities and become increasingly involved in the financial and commercial side of the company.



This position would particularly suit someone who wants real responsibility, broad business exposure and the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

About us

We are a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand in the wellness space. We run high volumes of paid video creative across Meta, and YouTube. Our creative is the engine of our growth, and we are scaling the volume and quality of what we produce using AI video tools. We need a senior editor who can lead that production.

You are a senior editor. You have years of experience editing short-form paid video for DTC or performance brands, and you can show us the work. You are a fit if

You have edited paid video that has actually run and driven results. You already use AI tools in your daily workflow, not as an experiment. You think in hooks, retention, and testing variations. You thrive on volume and speed. You have strong opinions about pacing, captions, sound design, and what makes creative perform.



You are not a fit if

You are early in your career. You need detailed direction on every project. You see AI tools as something you would like to learn rather than something you already use. You prioritize artistic polish over conversion performance.





How to apply

Send us your portfolio or reel of paid video work, a short note on which AI tools you use and how you use them in your workflow, and one example of an ad you edited that performed well and why you think it worked.

title: Operations Specialist - Real Estate Asset Management (ResMan)
description:
We are seeking a highly proactive, organized, and detail-oriented Operations Specialist to support our asset management team across our property portfolio. 



In this role, you will be responsible for daily oversight across our LCRO operational framework (Leasing, Collections, Renewals and Work Orders) to keep property managers accountable, remove operational bottlenecks, and maintain 100% data accuracy in ResMan.



You will act as the operational engine for our portfolio, ensuring tasks are completed on time, delinquencies are strictly managed, applications are processed rapidly, and signed leases are properly finalized in the system.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



• Daily LCRO Oversight & PM Guidance:

  - Monitor daily operational KPIs across Leasing, Collections, Work Orders, and Renewals.

  - Provide daily action items, task lists, and reminders to on-site Property Managers.

  - Conduct structured bi-daily reviews across assigned properties to verify compliance and offer hands-on support.



• Leasing & Application Turnaround (High Priority):

  - Audit applicant pipelines daily to ensure property managers process and approve applications rapidly before prospects turn to competing properties.

  - Identify delays in move-ins or screening and intervene to clear blockers.



• Collections & Delinquency Tracking (High Priority):

  - Track daily collection reports and verify that delinquency notes are updated continuously by property managers.

  - Follow up on non-payments and ensure timely eviction filings when deadlines are missed to mitigate financial risk.



• Lease Renewals & ResMan Data Integrity:

  - Audit completed lease renewals in ResMan. Ensure signed lease documents uploaded by managers are fully processed and updated as "Renewed" in ResMan to prevent false data in asset management forecasts.

  - Bridge communication gaps between property managers and leadership to maintain accurate occupancy forecasting.



• Work Orders & Resident Review Management:

  - Monitor open work order turnaround times to keep resident satisfaction high.

  - Ensure property teams prompt residents for Google Reviews immediately upon successful work order resolution.



QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS:

- Minimum 2+ years of experience in property management administrative support or real estate asset management support.

- Proven hands-on experience with ResMan software (or similar enterprise PM tools like Yardi/RealPage).

- Strong backbone for administrative accountability, comfortable following up firmly with property managers to enforce task completion.

- Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.

- Dedicated quiet home office setup with reliable high-speed internet and power backup.

title: Senior Amazon PPC Strategist & Perpetua Manager — Part-Time, Long-Term
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for an experienced Amazon PPC specialist to take strategic ownership of advertising for two established Amazon brands.



This is not a general virtual-assistant position or simply a bid-adjustment role. We already use Perpetua for automation. We need someone who can analyze the business behind the data, identify problems proactively, protect profitability, and develop growth opportunities.



The right person must be able to explain clearly:



What is happening in the accounts

Which products are improving or deteriorating

Where advertising is losing money

How PPC is affecting total sales and organic performance

What actions should be taken and why

Whether previous actions produced the intended results



RESPONSIBILITIES



Manage Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display

Review and manage Perpetua goals, target ACoS settings, budgets, and campaign structure

Analyze PPC sales, total sales, ACoS, TACOS, conversion, and profitability by product

Proactively identify wasted spending and urgent problems

Develop growth plans for priority products

Track important keywords and changes in organic ranking

Evaluate whether advertising is creating incremental growth or capturing existing sales

Provide a concise weekly owner-level report with findings, actions, results, and recommendations

Escalate urgent issues promptly

Maintain an accurate record of work performed and actual time spent



REQUIREMENTS



At least three years of hands-on Amazon PPC management experience

Recent hands-on experience with Perpetua is strongly preferred. Applicants whose primary experience is with a comparable Amazon PPC automation platform must clearly explain their Perpetua experience, if any

Strong knowledge of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display

Experience managing established Amazon brands, not only product launches

Strong understanding of ACoS, TACOS, contribution margin, conversion, keyword ranking, and organic sales

Proactive judgment and accountability

Clear spoken and written English

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

Availability for one short weekly meeting during New York business hours



HOURS AND COMPENSATION



Approximately 5–7 hours per week initially, depending on account needs and authorized work

Twenty paid hours per month during the initial trial, provided the agreed work and reporting are completed

Up to thirty hours may be authorized during the first month for account analysis and setup

Expected compensation: $8–$12 per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability

We are willing to pay more for a genuinely senior expert with strong, recent Perpetua experience and proven strategic ability

Please state your normal hourly rate in your application

Long-term opportunity if the trial is successful

All hours must be recorded with a brief description of the work performed



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words “PROFITABLE PPC.”



Please provide:



A brief description of your recent hands-on experience with Perpetua. Explain what settings, goals, budgets, or strategic decisions you personally managed.

One specific, anonymized example of an Amazon PPC problem you discovered proactively. Include the relevant numbers, what you changed, and the result.

Your requested hourly rate, desired weekly hours, and availability for meetings during New York business hours.

An anonymized example of a weekly PPC report you personally prepared for a business owner, if available.

A three-to-five-minute Loom video responding to the following situation:



One product has maintained a TACOS of approximately 70% for several weeks, while the rest of the brand has a TACOS below 10%. Explain what you would investigate first and how you would d
 whether to reduce, restructure, or pause its advertising.



Please do not create slides or read a prepared script. Speak naturally, as though you were explaining the situation to the business owner during a call. We are evaluating both your PPC reasoning and your ability to communicate clearly.



Candidates selected for the next stage will receive a small paid analytical assignment using exported account data. Account credentials will not be provided for the initial assignment.

Our team handles the creative direction and develops approved visual concepts, often using AI-generated designs as the starting point.



Your job is to take an approved concept and rebuild it professionally and accurately in Adobe InDesign.



You are not being hired to redesign or reinterpret the concept.



You should be able to look at an approved reference and think:



“I can recreate this very closely, correct the technical imperfections, and make it professionally production-ready.”



The goal is to preserve the approved creative direction while turning the concept into a clean, accurate, professional design.



What You Need to Be Excellent At

Adobe InDesign

Typography and type hierarchy

Grid systems

Precise spacing and positioning

Kerning, tracking, leading, and line spacing

Margins and gutters

Alignment and visual rhythm

Closely recreating reference designs

Working with photography within layouts

Bleeds, crops, safe areas, and print specifications

Preparing professional print-ready PDFs

Creating clean, editable, and organized source files



We care heavily about attention to detail.



You should notice when:



Something is a few millimeters out of alignment

Spacing is inconsistent

Type doesn't feel balanced

A margin is slightly wrong

A photograph isn't positioned correctly

Elements aren't following the underlying grid

Typography or spacing has been altered from the approved reference

Our Workflow



You may receive:



Approved AI design → reference files → logo/assets → photographs → dimensions → print specifications → creative notes



You will produce:



Accurate InDesign recreation → professionally corrected layout → print-ready PDF → organized editable InDesign package



AI-generated concepts may contain small technical imperfections.



We expect you to use your design knowledge to correct those issues while preserving the approved creative direction.



The goal is not to reinterpret the design.



The goal is to reproduce it professionally and accurately.



To Apply



Start your application with:



I WORK IN INDESIGN



Then send:



Your 3 strongest Adobe InDesign projects

At least one project demonstrating excellent typography

At least one project demonstrating strong grid, layout, and spacing discipline

At least one print-production project

A screenshot of one of your projects open in Adobe InDesign with grids, guides, margins, or other layout structure visible

Your expected rate

Your availability

Important



We specifically want to see evidence that you actually build layouts using grids, guides, typography systems, and precise spacing.



A beautiful final image by itself is not enough.



We want to see evidence of how you build the layout.



Paid Test



Shortlisted candidates will receive the same AI-generated reference design and the same original assets.



You will be asked to recreate a small design in Adobe InDesign.



The candidate ultimately selected for the role will be paid for the test.



We will evaluate the work based on:



Accuracy to the reference

Typography

Spacing

Alignment

Grid discipline

Photography placement

Attention to detail

Print-production setup

File organization

Overall technical execution



We are looking for a designer who can reproduce the approved reference faithfully, precisely, and professionally.



There is no need for a long interview process.



Show us how you work.



If the test is successful, there may be ongoing design and production work.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
The Creative Strategy Agency makes paid social ads for US DTC brands: UGC videos, statics and remixes that run on Meta.



We need a Creative Strategist to turn research into ads that sell. This role is 100% remote and we mostly work async, so you need to be able to work without your hand held. Our team is small, spread across the world, and amazing at what they do.



You can see the kind of work we do at 
.



What you'd do

- Dig into a brand, its customers, reviews and competitors to find angles worth testing

- Write clear briefs that editors, designers and creators can work from without guessing

- Write hooks, scripts and on-screen copy

- Look at which ads are working and use that to shape the next round

- Be the strategy voice for your clients: talk with them in Slack and run calls on performance and new angles



What you won't do

You won't manage the team, chase deadlines or handle approvals. Our operations manager does that. Your job is the strategy and the client conversations about it.



What you need

- 3+ years in creative strategy for paid social, at an agency or a DTC brand

- Near-native written English. You'll write copy that runs in front of US customers, and you'll be in writing with clients every week. This is the highest bar in the role

- A good ear for how real customers talk, and the habit of mining reviews and comments for it

- A portfolio of briefs or ads you wrote, and a sense of how they performed

- Experience owning client relationships directly: running the calls, walking them through results, and handling it when they aren't happy



Nice to have

- Experience briefing UGC creators

- Experience working in ClickUp

- Experience with health, wellness or personal care brands



You are perfect if:

- You will look for something to do if your desk clears instead of waiting to be told what to do

- You have a deep commitment to quality and take pride in your work

- You don't need perfect instructions and environments, you can make it work



What we offer

- A flexible schedule around your calls. Client calls and one team call a week sit in US Eastern hours, and you'll know about them in advance. Around those, work the hours that suit you. We need you reachable each working day, and past that nobody is watching the clock

- No set number of leave days. Take time off when you need it, just give us notice and make sure your work is covered. The one thing that doesn't work is going quiet, so we do need you around the rest of the time

- Philippine regular holidays, paid



The details

20 hours a week to start, $1,500/month. Full time is possible if we work well together, and the rate goes up with it. We're small enough that whoever takes this seat shapes how we do strategy, not just which ads get made.



To apply

- Put "I can find the angle" in the subject heading

- Send a portfolio of briefs or ads you've written

- Then pick a DTC brand you don't work for. In a short paragraph, tell us one angle you would test for them, and why you think it would work



If anything here is unclear, ask. We'd rather answer questions than get a guess

title: Amazon Fba product sourcer (Online arbitrage, Wholesale arbitrage)
description:
Looking for an experienced Amazon FBA sourcer to find profitable online 

arbitrage leads for our store. Must already be comfortable with SellerAmp 

and Keepa — this is not an entry-level/training role.



Hours: 25 hours/week required

Pay: Flat weekly rate (based on experience — mention your rate expectations 

when applying)

Quota: Minimum 5-10 vetted leads per day, logged in our shared Google Sheet

Reporting: Google Sheet must be updated daily — no batching leads to dump 

at the end of the week

Performance: Repeated missed quotas or unreported days will result in a 

warning, then pay adjustment, then termination if it continues



What you'll do:

- Reverse source: go through other sellers' storefronts on Amazon to find 

 what they're selling, then locate that same product cheaper from the 

 retailer/website they likely sourced it from

- Vet every lead using Keepa (price history, sales rank history, seller 

 count over time) and SellerAmp (ROI, fees, profitability, eligibility)

- Check BSR (Best Seller Rank) against category requirements to confirm 

 it's a fast enough mover before submitting a lead

- Confirm eligibility/ungating status on each ASIN before adding it to 

 the list — don't submit gated items unless already approved

- Flag any IP complaint risk, hazmat, or restricted brand issues

- Update the shared Google Sheet daily with: product name, buy link, cost, 

 sell price, ROI %, BSR, and eligibility status for every lead found

- OFFER COUNT MUST BE LOW



What you need to already know:

-We are gated on lots of products due to us being a new seller

- SellerAmp (SAS) — pulling ROI/profitability and running eligibility checks

- Keepa — reading price/rank history charts, spotting stable vs. volatile 

 listings

- Reverse sourcing / storefront stalking methodology

- What BSR ranges are actually sourceable per category (not just "low 

 number = good")

- Amazon's restricted categories, gated brands, and common IP-risk red 

 flags



Access provided:

- Your own restricted Seller Central login (Inventory access only — no 

 orders, payments, or financial data)

- Shared SellerAmp login for research

- Shared Google Sheet for daily lead logging

- You will connect YOUR OWN Seller Central login inside SellerAmp when 

 prompted — do not use any other login



To apply: send 2-3 sample leads with your reasoning (Keepa chart read, 

ROI calc, why you picked it). Shortlisted applicants will hop on a call 

to be interviewed before final hire.

title: AI Video Creator for Premium Product Commercials (Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Runway)
description:
We're a US startup building consumer apps that help college students find housing. We're looking for an AI-native video creator to own all of our AI video work: product launches, feature showcases, brand commercials and social ads.



Think Apple-style rollout videos. Real student life on camera, like moving into a first apartment, finding the right roommate, or a phone lighting up with good news, with product features woven in cleanly.



This role starts part time (20 hrs/week). If it goes well, it grows into full time with higher pay and ownership of our whole video and creative output.



WHAT YOU'LL MAKE

- Hero commercials (15, 30 and 60 seconds) for product launches

- Feature spots that each show one product feature

- Vertical cutdowns for Reels, TikTok and Shorts, plus 16:9 and 1:1 versions

- Ad variants for testing on a regular cadence

- Brand and social video across more than one product



HOW YOU'LL MAKE IT

- AI video generation: Higgsfield (Cinema Studio, Soul ID, Marketing Studio), Google Veo 3.1 / Flow, Kling 3.0, Seedance 2.0, Runway Gen-4.5

- Keeping characters consistent across shots and campaigns

- Compositing real app screens into AI footage so phones and laptops show the actual product

- Editing, pacing, sound design, music and kinetic typography (CapCut, Premiere or DaVinci, plus After Effects)

- AI voiceover and lip sync (ElevenLabs, HeyGen or similar) when needed



YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU

- Have a portfolio of AI-generated commercials or product videos that look premium, not "AI slop"

- Know which model to use for which shot and why

- Can turn a short brief into your own shot list and prompts

- Keep up with new tools every month and bring them to us before we ask

- Have a clean, restrained eye: natural light, real-feeling people, typography that breathes

- Communicate clearly in English and give updates without being chased



NICE TO HAVE

- Consumer app, real estate or student-focused brand experience

- Basic motion design or 3D (Blender, Spline)

- Performance ad experience (hook testing, variant builds)



GROWTH

- Start at 20 hrs/week

- Path to full time with a raise once volume and quality are proven

- Room to lead creative direction across our products



DETAILS

- Tool subscriptions are paid by us

- 2 to 3 hours of overlap with US Eastern mornings

- All work is owned by the company. You'll sign a confidentiality and IP assignment agreement.

- No real people's likeness, no copyrighted music or footage, and only tools whose terms allow commercial use

- Shortlisted applicants complete a short paid trial ($60)



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the words "Cinema Studio" so we know you read this.

2. Send 3 links to AI video work you made. For each one, tell us which tools you used and what you did yourself.

3. Answer these questions:

 a. For your best piece, which AI tools did you use and what did you do yourself?

 b. What new AI video tool are you excited about right now?

 c. What hours are you available (USA time)? Open to full time later?



Applications without portfolio links won't be reviewed.

title: Part-Time Operations & Executive Assistant
description:
We're a growing content and marketing company working primarily in the real estate industry, and we're looking for a highly organized Operations & Executive Assistant to work directly with the founder and help keep the business running smoothly.



This is a flexible part-time position.



There are no strict 8-hour shifts. Some days may only require a small amount of work, while other days may require a couple of hours depending on what's happening in the business.



What matters is that you're responsive, organized, professional, and plugged into what's happening with the company.



What You'll Help With



You'll work directly with the founder and assist with things such as:



Scheduling and organizing calls

Calendar management

Following up on leads and appointments

Client communication and follow-ups

Helping with client onboarding

Assisting with our weekly newsletter

Updating spreadsheets, trackers and internal systems

Helping manage applicants during our hiring process

Coordinating interviews and paid hiring tests

Communicating with team members

Organizing documents and SOPs

Research and administrative tasks

Making sure important tasks don't fall through the cracks

Helping with miscellaneous operational projects as they come up



The responsibilities may change from week to week, so we're looking for someone comfortable wearing multiple hats.



What We're Looking For



The most important qualities for this position are:



Extremely detail-oriented

Excellent written English

Professional communication

Reliable and responsive

Organized

Proactive

Able to follow instructions carefully

Comfortable asking questions when something isn't clear

Able to double-check your own work

Able to understand the bigger picture of the business instead of only completing individual tasks



You don't need to know all of our systems immediately.



We'll teach you how the company operates.



However, we want someone who learns quickly and eventually understands our clients, team, offers, workflow and how the business works without needing everything explained repeatedly.



Availability



This is a flexible part-time role, not a traditional fixed-hour job.



Most days may involve approximately 1–3 hours of work, sometimes less.



You should be available to periodically check messages and handle tasks throughout the working day rather than only logging in once per day.



Some overlap with U.S. Pacific Time business hours is required.



We do not expect you to be online 24/7.



Compensation



$300–$500 USD per month, depending on experience, availability and performance.



We're looking for someone who wants to stay with the company long-term.



As the company grows and you take on more responsibility, there will be opportunities for the role and compensation to grow as well.



How to Apply



At the very top of your application, write:



DETAILS MATTER



Then send:



A short introduction about yourself.

Your experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant or Operations Assistant.

Your normal working hours in Philippine Time.

How much overlap you can provide with U.S. Pacific Time.

The software and tools you've worked with.

A 60–90 second video introducing yourself and explaining why you'd be a strong fit for this role.



Please also answer:



Imagine I message you asking you to schedule an important client call. The calendar says 10:00 AM, our spreadsheet says 11:00 AM, and the last client message mentions 10:30 AM. Walk me through exactly what you would do before confirming anything with the client.



We're looking for someone who takes ownership, pays attention to details and can become a trusted part of the company.

title: Outbound Sales & Relationship Specialist
description:
We are looking for a confident, persuasive, and highly professional Outbound Sales & Relationship Specialist who is excellent on the phone and knows how to turn new conversations into productive business relationships.



This is NOT a position for someone who simply reads a script, asks a few questions, and logs the call.



We need someone who can think during a conversation, build rapport, explain a business opportunity clearly, overcome objections, follow up consistently, and move interested contacts toward the next step.



What You’ll Do



You will be responsible for making outbound calls to rental property owners and other real estate contacts to determine whether they are open to working with our clients.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Make outbound calls to new and existing contacts

- Introduce our rental model clearly and professionally

- Build rapport and establish trust during conversations

- Explain how our clients would use the rental property

- Ask the right questions to determine interest and fit

- Handle questions, concerns, and objections confidently

- Ask thoughtful follow-up questions instead of immediately accepting the first “no”

- Follow up with interested contacts by phone, text, and

- Discuss rental terms and identify potential areas of agreement

- Keep conversations moving toward tours and potential lease agreements

- Re-engage interested contacts when appropriate

- Maintain detailed and accurate notes in the CRM

- Keep follow-up tasks organized and completed on time

- Communicate important updates to the internal team

- Escalate questions or situations that require management approval



Who We’re Looking For



You should be someone who is naturally comfortable speaking with people and does not become nervous or robotic when a conversation goes off-script.



You should be able to listen, think, respond, and confidently guide a conversation.



We are specifically looking for someone who:



- Has strong outbound sales, business development, lead generation, or phone-based sales experience

- Has experience initiating conversations with prospective customers, clients, or business contacts

- Has excellent spoken English

- Sounds confident, professional, and natural on the phone

- Is comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

- Knows how to build rapport quickly

- Can handle objections without becoming defensive or immediately giving up

- Knows how to ask follow-up questions and uncover the real concern behind an objection

- Can explain an unfamiliar business concept in simple terms

- Is persuasive without being aggressive

- Can discuss terms and identify mutually beneficial solutions

- Is persistent with follow-up

- Has strong attention to detail

- Is comfortable using a CRM

- Can work independently without needing constant direction

- Is organized and reliable



Important Experience Requirements



Experience working in a BPO or call center is welcome; however, inbound customer service with occasional upselling is not the same as the outbound sales experience required for this position.



We are specifically interested in candidates who have experience initiating outbound conversations, developing new business relationships, handling initial resistance, overcoming objections, and moving prospects toward a decision or next step.



If your previous role primarily involved answering incoming customer service calls and offering upgrades or additional products to existing customers, please do not describe that as outbound sales experience in your application.



This Position Is NOT For You If:



- Your experience is primarily inbound customer service with occasional upselling

- You are uncomfortable initiating outbound conversations

- You rely heavily on reading scripts word-for-word

- You struggle when someone asks a question that isn’t in the script

- You immediately end the conversation when someone raises an objection

- You are afraid to ask follow-up questions

- You prefer administrative work over speaking with people

- You need constant supervision to complete follow-ups

- You have difficulty keeping detailed CRM notes



What Success Looks Like



A successful person in this role doesn’t simply make calls.



They create conversations.



They identify interested contacts, build relationships, handle concerns, follow up consistently, and help move viable opportunities from the initial conversation toward a tour and potential signed lease.



We’re looking for someone who can confidently take ownership of that process.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



**1. Tell us about your outbound sales or business development experience. What were you selling or discussing, and who were you contacting?



**2. In your most recent phone-based sales role, were you primarily initiating outbound calls or answering inbound calls?Please explain.



**3. Approximately how many outbound calls were you responsible for making per day?



**4.Tell us about a situation where someone initially said “no” or raised an objection, but you were able to keep the conversation going. What did you do?



**5. MANDATORY: Send a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and briefly explaining why you believe you are strong at outbound sales and building relationships over the phone.



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



Please do not send a generic application. We are specifically looking for someone with strong phone communication, outbound sales ability, objection handling, relationship-building, and follow-up skills.

title: AI Product Engineer — Full-Stack SaaS
description:
We're building a custom operating system for pest control companies, and we're looking for an exceptional product engineer who can help us build and ship it FAST.



This is not a traditional developer role where you'll receive perfectly written tickets and detailed technical specifications.



You'll often be given:

- The business problem

- The outcome we need

- Existing product context

- Screenshots/mockups/examples

- Customer feedback

- Access to the current codebase and data



Your job is to figure out the best way to build it and take it all the way from idea → working production feature.



We're looking for someone who combines strong full-stack development ability with excellent product judgment and uses modern AI development tools to move extremely fast.



If you're the type of developer who can be told: "Here's the problem. Here's what the user needs to be able to do. Figure out how to build it."



…and then come back with a working product, keep reading.





What We're Building



PestLaunch helps pest control companies grow, improve profitability and build better operations.



We're building our own SaaS platform that becomes the operating system for these businesses.



The platform includes things like:

- Executive business dashboards

- CRM integrations

- Sales and lead pipelines

- Call tracking, recordings and transcripts

- AI call classification and scoring

- AI coaching

- Financial / QuickBooks integrations

- KPI and scorecard tracking

- Customer health

- Business diagnostics

- AI recommendations

- Tasks and notifications

- Campaign tracking

- Client implementation workflows

- Training portals

- Search

- Forms

- Internal/client communication

- Reporting and analytics



Our goal is to move extremely quickly and turn this into a product our clients use every day.



What You'll Own

You'll personally build and ship major parts of the product.



Depending on your strengths, that may include:

- Building complete product features from concept to production

- Front-end and back-end development

- Database architecture

- Dashboards and reporting

- API integrations

- CRM integrations

- AI features and workflows

- Authentication and permissions

- Search

- Notifications

- Data processing and normalization

- Internal admin tools

- Debugging and performance improvements

- Testing and QA

- Deployment



You'll work directly with the founder/product owner and another developer.



Individual features will have clear ownership so you can move quickly without waiting for someone to tell you every step.



What We're Looking For



You should have strong evidence that you've personally built real software products.



Ideally, you have experience with:

- Full-stack SaaS development

- React / Next.js or similar modern frameworks

- Databases such as PostgreSQL / Supabase

- APIs, webhooks and third-party integrations

- Authentication and permissions

- SaaS dashboards and reporting

- AI APIs / LLM integrations

- Modern deployment platforms such as Vercel

- Git / GitHub

- Building production software from scratch



Experience with tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar AI coding tools is strongly preferred.



Experience building CRM, ERP, field-service, home-service, business operations or vertical SaaS products is a major plus.



Experience integrating platforms such as QuickBooks, Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, Jobber, FieldRoutes, PestPac, GorillaDesk, GoHighLevel or similar systems is also a major plus.



The Person We're Looking For



We're NOT looking for someone who needs every feature broken into detailed development tickets.



We're looking for someone who:

- Figures things out

- Moves extremely fast

- Has strong product judgment

- Can understand business workflows, not just code

- Keeps solutions simple when simple works

- Uses AI aggressively to increase development speed

- Can learn unfamiliar APIs/software quickly

- Tests their own work

- Cares about data accuracy

- Notices edge cases

- Communicates blockers quickly

- Finishes what they start

- Can independently own a feature from idea through production





How to Apply



Please send a 5–7 minute Loom video answering the following.



1. Show us the best SaaS/product you've personally built.

Actually open the product and show it working. Do not just show screenshots or slides.



2. Tell us exactly what YOU built.



What did you personally architect, design and code?

What was built by other developers?



3. Explain the technical architecture.



Briefly show us:

- Front end

- Back end

- Database

- APIs/integrations

- Hosting/deployment



Keep this high level.



4. Show us something you've built using AI coding tools.



Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar.

Tell us approximately how long it took you to build.



5. Show us an example where you were given a BUSINESS PROBLEM rather than detailed technical specifications.



What were you told?

How did you d
 what needed to be built?

What did you personally build?

What was the result?



6. Tell us how you would approach this role.



You're joining an existing SaaS product with an existing developer and a large roadmap.

Your goal is to dramatically increase how quickly we ship high-quality features.

How would you approach your first 30 days?





Important: We care much more about seeing real things you've personally shipped than hearing polished answers about software development.



If you cannot show us a real product you've personally built, this probably isn't the right role.

title: HIGH LEVEL PHONE CLOSER
description:
A.C.E Digital Consulting

US Phone Closer — Product Is Already Built, You Just Close (50% commission)



We're a US web design company, and here's what makes this easy money: we've ALREADY built a complete, live website for every business you'll call. You're not cold-pitching air — you're calling a small-business owner to show him the finished website we made for HIS company, and closing him on keeping it. The product is done. Your only job is the phone.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Call US small-business owners (plumbers, electricians, other trades) on their cell.

- Show them the website we already built for them.

- Close the sale on the call — paid by card right there.

- All leads and software (GoHighLevel) provided. You just dial and close.



WHO WE WANT — READ CAREFULLY

- 5+ years PHONE SALES experience CLOSING US CONSUMERS (B2C) — solar, insurance/final expense, home improvement, home services, alarms, etc. One-call closing.

- A PROVEN, DOCUMENTED TRACK RECORD. You can show real numbers — close rate, deals per month, revenue closed — and back them up with references and/or recordings of you actually closing. No proof, no interview.

- This is NOT B2B, NOT enterprise, NOT appointment-setting. If that's your background, this isn't the fit.

- You are a CLOSER: you handle objections and ask for the credit card without flinching.

- Excellent, neutral, confident spoken English — a US owner must trust you in the first 10 seconds.

- Reliable high-speed internet, quality headset, quiet place to work.

- Able to work US Eastern hours, ~8:00 AM–1:00 PM ET (about 8:00 PM–1:00 AM PH time — a night shift here). That's when owners answer; reliability in these hours is required.



PAY — COMMISSION ONLY

- You earn 50% of every website you sell — no caps.

- We recommend selling at $2,000, but the price is yours to work. Whatever you close and we collect on the website, you get half.

  - Example: close at $2,000 → you get $1,000. Close at $800 → you get $400.

- Paid as soon as the payment clears in our Stripe (they pay by card on the call — it's fast).

- Hosting and maintenance are a separate company service — not part of your commission. You sell websites; we handle the rest.

- Your commission scales with the price you hold. The harder you close, the more YOU make — a strong closer makes serious money here.



TO APPLY (or you'll be ignored)

1. Start your message with the word CLOSER so I know you read this.

2. Attach a 60-second voice recording: introduce yourself, then give your best 30-second pitch for anything you've sold — in English.

3. Prove it: your years closing US B2C customers, which products, your close rate, and references or call recordings I can verify.

No voice recording + no "CLOSER" + no proof = no reply.

title: Virtual Assistant — Social Media & Community
description:
About TaperClinic



TaperClinic is the world's premier psychiatric drug tapering program, founded by Dr. Josef Witt-Doerring, a board-certified psychiatrist and former FDA medical officer. We help people safely come off psychiatric medications and rebuild their health with a multidisciplinary team behind them. Our content, Dr. Josef's YouTube channel, Instagram, and other social platforms, reaches millions of people every month, many of whom are looking for answers they can't get anywhere else.



That audience is why this role exists. Every comment and DM is a person, often one in a hard season of their life, and how we respond is part of the care we provide.



Role Overview



We're looking for a self-sufficient, proactive virtual assistant to manage our social media community and support our content operations. You'll be the first touchpoint for the people who reach out to us every day, keep our comment sections healthy, and produce simple graphics and stories that match our brand.



This role starts at 10 hours per week with room to grow as you demonstrate ownership. We are specifically looking for a go-getter: someone who sees what needs doing and does it, flags problems before we find them, and doesn't need daily direction to deliver.



Responsibilities

Respond to comments and DMs across our platforms (Instagram, YouTube,
, X) in TaperClinic's voice, warm, clear, and on-message, using our response guidelines and templates.

Moderate comment sections: remove spam, hide abusive content, and keep discussions safe and respectful.

Escalate, never advise. Route medical questions to the clinic team and follow our crisis protocol immediately for any message suggesting someone may be in danger. You will never give medical advice, and we will train you on exactly what to say and who to alert.

Create Instagram stories and graphics from our templates and brand assets.

Build UTM links for campaigns and posts as needed so we can track what's working.

Flag recurring questions, notable comments, and content ideas from the community to the marketing team.

What Success Looks Like

Comments and DMs receive timely, on-brand responses, and nothing urgent slips through.

Our comment sections stay clean, safe, and welcoming.

Stories and graphics go out consistently and look like us.

Links are tagged correctly and the team trusts the tracking.

You've made this corner of the operation something we don't have to think about.

Qualifications

Excellent written English with a warm, professional tone.

Experience managing social media accounts, community inboxes, or online communities (personal or professional).

Basic design skills in Canva or similar; comfort working from templates.

Organized, reliable, and detail-oriented; comfortable with spreadsheets and link builders (we'll teach you our UTM conventions).

Sound judgment and discretion. Our DMs can include sensitive personal health information, and confidentiality is non-negotiable.

Emotional maturity for a mental health audience: patience with people who are struggling, and the judgment to know when something needs a human above your pay grade, fast.

Self-starter who works independently, meets deadlines, and communicates proactively.

Bonus: familiarity with the mental health space, ManyChat or similar DM automation, and basic video/Reels editing.

Compensation & Details

Rate: $15/hour

Hours: 10 hours per week to start, with growth potential based on performance

Location: Fully remote

Schedule: Flexible, but consistent daily coverage of comments/DMs is required

Type: Independent contractor (1099)

How to Apply



Send us: (1) a short note on why this role fits you, (2) links or screenshots of social accounts or graphics you've worked on, and (3) a sample reply to this DM: "I've been on antidepressants for 6 years and I want to get off. Can Dr. Josef help me?"

title: Carrier Retention Specialist Win-Back & Reactivation | 123Loadboard | Fully Remote
description:
About 123Loadboard

Founded in 2004, 123Loadboard provides a freight matching marketplace for carriers, owner-operators, brokers, 

and shippers to move more freight across North America. With 35,000 active carriers, we deliver load matching, 

credit, compliance, and mileage tools through affordable web and mobile app platforms that help professional 

truck drivers find loads and increase their loaded miles. As one of North America's longest-running digital 

freight-matching platforms, 123Loadboard is known for helping carriers and brokers find loads and keep trucks 

moving. We are partnered with 30+ companies serving the transportation industry, and we compete to be 

recognized as the leading provider of freight and transportation equipment solutions using state-of-the-art tools 

that inspire customer loyalty, boost acquisition, and grow profits.

The Opportunity

The Carrier Retention Specialist owns the win-back mission: bringing churned, non-pay, and lapsed carrier 

accounts back onto 123Loadboard and keeping them active. This role is measured on reactivation revenue and 

recovered subscriptions within a dedicated book of business. It combines proactive outreach to at-risk and 

recently churned carriers, diagnosis of the root causes behind cancellations and non-payments, and execution of 

segmented win-back campaigns that get owner-operators and fleets posting, booking, and paying again.

This person is the carrier's advocate at the moment they are most likely to leave. They translate churn signals 

and reactivation patterns into actionable intelligence for Sales, Product, Marketing, and Support, closing the 

loop on why carriers leave and what brings them back.

This is a fully remote, work-from-home opportunity.

What You'll Do

Win-Back & Reactivation

• Own a reactivation revenue quota, recovering churned, non-pay, and lapsed carrier accounts back to 

active, paying subscriptions.

• Build and run a 30-day-plus win-back program with defined conversion targets, outreach cadences, and 

follow-up sequences.

• Develop reactivation strategies for non-pays and churned carriers, segmented by rep, territory, product, 

and equipment type.

• Prioritize outreach using recency, prior spend, load activity, and churn reason to focus effort on the 

highest-value recoverable accounts.

• Execute multi-touch win-back campaigns across phone,
, and SMS, tailoring the offer and messaging 

to each carrier segment.

• Position win-back offers, plan changes, and promotions to overcome the specific objection that drove the 

cancellation.

• Track and report on self-service and assisted reactivation rates; build profiles of successful win-backs to 

refine playbooks.

At-Risk & Churn Prevention

• Proactively identify and work at-risk carrier accounts using Salesforce reports, usage data, and paymentfailure signals before they churn.

• Intervene with early-lifecycle carriers who are not yet posting, searching, or booking at target levels to 

prevent avoidable churn.

• Recover failed and declined payments through direct outreach, updated billing, and plan right-sizing.

• Serve as first line of support for retention-related account and billing questions, resolving directly or 

routing to the right internal team.

Voice of the Churned Carrier

• Use exit reasons, C-Sat scores, surveys, and win-back conversations to understand churn drivers and close 

feedback loops.

• Own the method and cadence for collecting and reporting churn and reactivation intelligence to Product, 

Marketing, and Sales.

• Analyze and synthesize feedback into actionable reporting with sufficient detail to inform product, pricing, 

and offer decisions.

• Represent the carrier perspective in cross-functional meetings, especially the reasons carriers leave and the 

levers that bring them back.

Book & Territory Intelligence

• Maintain a working understanding of your book: churn rates and reasons, equipment mix, seasonality, 

competitive pressure, and reactivation potential.

• Profile your highest-value recoverable accounts, covering fleet size, prior spend, products used, 

competitive presence, and win-back likelihood.

• Use reactivation data to build win-back strategies and identify patterns that predict which carriers are most 

recoverable.

Cross-Functional Alignment

• Ensure win-back processes, training, and focus align with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Support teams.

• Partner with Marketing on lifecycle and win-back campaign design, offers, and messaging.

• Participate in OKR cycles, Quarterly Business Reviews, and weekly supervisor meetings.

The Skills and Experience You'll Bring

• 2-3 years of experience in retention, win-back, customer success, inside sales, or account management, 

ideally with a churn or reactivation quota.

• Persuasive, resilient communicator who thrives on outbound outreach and turning a "no" into a renewed 

relationship.

• Deep understanding of the freight and logistics industry and the daily realities of carriers and owneroperators.

• Comfortable working churn data, Salesforce reports, and segmentation to prioritize and personalize 

outreach at volume.

• Detail-oriented, adaptable multi-tasker who can manage a high-volume book in a fast-paced environment.

• Strategic thinker who can diagnose why carriers leave and design the offers and cadences that bring them 

back

title: Social Media & UGC Manager (Remote)
description:
About Trill Paws



Trill Paws creates premium pet ID tags with personality. Our mission is to build a brand that dog lovers genuinely enjoy following, not just a company that sells pet tags.



We're looking for someone who is excited about social media, influencer marketing, and building an engaged community around our brand.



About the Role



We're looking for a Social Media & UGC Manager to own our Instagram and TikTok presence.



Your biggest responsibility is creating a reliable stream of great content by building relationships with creators, managing influencer collaborations, and turning that content into an engaging social media presence.



This is a long-term, remote role for someone who is proactive, organized, and loves helping brands grow.



What You'll Do

UGC & Influencer Marketing (Highest Priority)

-Research and identify creators who fit the Trill Paws brand.

-Reach out to influencers and UGC creators.

-Coordinate gifting campaigns and product shipments.

-Build long-term relationships with creators.

-Maintain a pipeline of fresh content every month.

-Track collaborations and follow up to ensure content is delivered.



Social Media Management

-Plan and maintain a monthly content calendar.

-Schedule and publish content on Instagram and TikTok.

-Write engaging captions that match our brand voice.

-Respond to comments and direct messages.

-Engage with other accounts in the pet community.

-Monitor trends and recommend content ideas.



Content Editing

-Polish creator content when needed.

-Add captions, hooks, music, and branding.

-Repurpose one video into multiple pieces of content across Instagram and TikTok.



Reporting

-Share a simple weekly report covering:

-Top-performing content

-Engagement

-Influencer progress

-Ideas for the following week



What We're Looking For

-Excellent written English.

-Experience managing Instagram and TikTok.

-Experience working with influencers or UGC creators.

-Comfortable editing short-form video using CapCut (or similar).

-Canva experience.

-Highly organized and dependable.

-Self-starter who doesn't need constant direction.

-Passion for dogs is a huge plus.



Bonus Skills

-Shopify experience.

-Experience with e-commerce brands.

-Meta Business Suite.

-TikTok Creator Marketplace.

-Basic graphic design.



Hours

-Approximately 10 hours per week.

-Flexible schedule.

-Some overlap with U.S. Pacific Time is preferred.



What Success Looks Like

After 90 days, we'd love to see:



-A consistent flow of new UGC from creators each month.

-Instagram and TikTok posting consistently.

-An engaged community that responds to our content.

-Organized influencer partnerships and follow-ups.

-Fresh content ideas being brought to the team regularly.



How to Apply

Please include:

-A short introduction about yourself.

-Links to social media accounts you've managed.

-Examples of influencer or UGC campaigns you've worked on (if applicable).

We're looking for someone who wants to become a key part of our team for years to come. If you're excited about building relationships with creators, growing social media, and helping build one of the most loved dog brands online, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Virtual Receptionist / Lead Qualifier — U.S. Construction Company
description:
Virtual Receptionist / Lead Qualifier — U.S. Construction Company



Company: Superior Drywall & Finishing LLC

Location: Northwest Arkansas (remote)

Employment: Full-time

Starting pay: $3.00 USD/hour

Schedule: 8:00am–5:00pm Central Time, Monday–Friday



Pay increases are available based on performance and increased responsibility.



ABOUT THE ROLE



Superior Drywall & Finishing LLC is a growing drywall company serving Northwest Arkansas. We are hiring a full-time Virtual Receptionist / Lead Qualifier to be the first person our customers speak with.



You will answer incoming business phone calls from 8:00am–5:00pm Central Time, Monday–Friday, and help us qualify leads, collect accurate information, and schedule estimate appointments.



This is a phone-heavy role. You must be confident speaking English on the phone all day.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Collect accurate customer information

- Enter lead information into our systems

- Schedule estimate appointments when appropriate

- Take detailed messages

- Route calls to the appropriate team member

- Follow up with leads when instructed

- Communicate with our team throughout the day



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Excellent spoken English

- Clear pronunciation and easy-to-understand speech

- Strong listening skills

- Professional phone presence

- Confidence talking to customers

- Friendly but direct communication

- Good attention to detail

- Reliable internet, computer, and headset/microphone

- Quiet working environment

- Ability to work 8:00am–5:00pm U.S. Central Time, Monday–Friday

- Ability to learn scripts and processes

- Ability to use CRM/software systems

- Strong follow-up skills



Construction experience is helpful but NOT required.



Customer service, receptionist, call center, appointment setting, or lead qualification experience is preferred.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)



We use these instructions to see who actually reads the job posting.



At the VERY TOP of your application, write exactly:



PHONE READY



If "PHONE READY" is not at the top of your application, your application may be marked for special review.



REQUIRED VIDEO (DO NOT SKIP)



Every applicant must submit a 1–2 minute video or Loom recording.



Do NOT heavily edit the video. We want to hear how you naturally communicate.



Your recording must include:



1. Your name and a short introduction.

2. Why you believe you would be good at answering phone calls for a U.S.-based construction company.

3. A mock phone greeting where you say:



"Thank you for calling Superior Drywall & Finishing, this is [NAME]. How can I help you?"



4. A short roleplay responding to this imaginary customer:



"Hi, I'm remodeling my house and I need someone to replace some drywall and texture a few rooms. I'm trying to get an estimate."



Respond naturally as if this were a real incoming phone call. Attempt to gather useful information from the customer rather than simply giving a scripted answer.



Include the link to your video in your application (question 9 below).



SCREENING QUESTIONS



Please answer all of the following in your application:



1. Are you currently working another job? If yes, what hours?

2. Are you available to work 8:00am–5:00pm Central Time, MondayFriday?

3. How many years of customer service, receptionist, appointment-setting, sales, or call-center experience do you have?

4. Have you previously answered phone calls for a U.S.-based company?

5. What CRM or business software have you used?

6. Describe what you would do if a customer called upset about a project.

7. What internet connection do you have and what backup do you have if your internet goes down?

8. What equipment do you use for calls?

9. Provide the link to your required video.

10. Why should we trust you to be the first person our customers speak with?



Superior Drywall & Finishing LLC — Northwest Arkansas

We're looking for a dependable long-term Virtual Receptionist / Lead Qualifier who represents our company professionally on every call.

title: Cost Controller, Earned Value (EVM), EPC, Energy and Data Center Projects
description:
We are a US project controls firm hiring Cost and Change Specialists for capital projects in industrial, EPC, energy and data center / mission-critical work. You will own the control budget, forecast and earned value reporting, and run the change process that keeps the budget current.



Hands-on earned value management (EVM) is required. If you have not personally reported CPI / SPI on a live project, this role is not a fit.



SCHEDULE

Full time, Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central (9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Manila; one hour later from November to March). Long-term role.



PAY

$1,300 to $2,600 USD per month depending on experience. Paid monthly.

- 3+ years: Specialist level

- 7+ years: Senior level

- 12+ years: Lead level



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Set up and maintain the control budget and cost breakdown structure; reconcile to the estimate and contract

- Track commitments, accruals and actuals; produce the monthly cost report and EAC / ETC forecast with variance explanations

- Measure progress and earned value; report CPI / SPI and what is driving the forecast

- Run the trend and change process: log and price potential changes, route for approval, update the budget

- Review contractor pay applications against progress and contract terms; maintain the cash flow forecast

- Maintain the change log, contingency drawdown and management reserve



REQUIRED

- 3+ years in project cost control

- Hands-on EVM: maintaining the performance measurement baseline, measuring earned value against planned value and actual cost, reporting CPI / SPI

- Owned a monthly cost report, EAC and change log on a live project

- Hands-on ERP (SAP, Oracle, JD Edwards) or project cost system (Ecosys, Unifier, InEight, Cobra, Prism) within the last 3 years, plus advanced Excel

- At least one industrial, EPC, oil and gas, power or data center project carried through construction

- Strong written English



NICE TO HAVE

- AACE CCP, EVP or CCT, or PMP

- Deltek Cobra or Ecosys

- Able to read and analyze P6 schedules

- Power BI



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "CPI". Then tell us:

1. A time your EAC moved significantly in one month: what drove it and how you explained it

2. The cost system you used most recently and when

3. Your expected monthly rate in USD



Applications without these answers will not be reviewed.

title: Video Editor | YouTube + Reels
description:
# Video Editor for SCALE Academy | YouTube + Reels



SCALE Academy helps service business owners grow stronger companies through practical business education, experienced mentors, live Q&A, tools, and a community of entrepreneurs. We’re looking for a video editor who can turn our founder-led videos, expert conversations, and educational recordings into exceptional YouTube videos, Reels, and Shorts.



We want someone with strong editorial judgment. You should know how to find the point of a video, open with the most compelling moment, remove what slows it down, and keep viewers engaged **without making thoughtful business content feel gimmicky**.



## What you’ll edit



*Youtube long form videos, including short previews of them for sharing.  Should be highly skilled in thumbnails, titles and Youtube videos.

* Founder-led YouTube videos, interviews, expert sessions, and educational content.  Helping our educational content go viral.

* Short Reels and YouTube Shorts created from both dedicated recordings and longer videos.

* Occasional promotional videos or ad variations.



You’ll help choose strong clips and shape them into complete ideas. A short should make sense on its own, rather than feel like a random excerpt from a longer conversation.



## What great work looks like to us



* A strong opening that gives the right business owner a reason to keep watching.

* Tight pacing that preserves the speaker’s personality and meaning.

* Clean audio, consistent color, polished cuts, and readable, accurate captions.

* Graphics, screen recordings, or B-roll when they clarify an idea. No clutter or effects added just to fill the screen.

* Professional YouTube edits that make longer ideas easy to follow, plus vertical edits designed for Reels and Shorts.

* Good judgment about which moments are worth publishing and which are not.



Our audience is made up of business owners. The work should feel sharp, credible, energetic, and human—not like a generic motivational video.



## How we’ll work together



We’ll provide source footage, brand assets, context on the audience, and feedback. We’d like you to bring ideas about hooks, structure, clip selection, and ways to improve the final video. You should be comfortable working with high-resolution camera footage as well as Zoom or screen-recorded material.



Please deliver finished videos in the formats we agree on, along with editable project files and organized assets. Communicate clearly about timelines and flag problems early. We’re looking for an ongoing relationship and will set a realistic production schedule together.



## To apply, please send



1. **Two YouTube videos and three short videos you personally edited.** Tell us what you did on each.

2. One example where you made a talking-head video or interview significantly more engaging through your editing decisions.

3. The software you use, your availability, and your hourly or project-based rate.

4. A brief answer: If we gave you a 20-minute conversation with a business expert, how would you d
 which moments should become Reels?



We’ll invite a small number of finalists to complete the **same paid test edit** with SCALE footage. We care most about your storytelling, taste, attention to detail, and ability to understand the audience.



Please only apply if you are highly skilled and have the capacity to create high level content.  Must understand hooks, long form YouTube video dynamics and watchability, as well as how to break down short form for short and long form to work together to build credibility and brand awareness.  



Open to part time or gig.  May end up being full time soon.

description:

Customers choose from 30+ historic and modern firearms, including the M134 Minigun, Thompson, .50 Cal, MP5, AK-47, M4, and more. **The Opportunity**

- Build a content plan and posting calendar

- Research keywords and competitors; write titles, descriptions, and tags that get found

- Track analytics (CTR, retention, watch time) and adjust based on what the data shows

**Nice to Have**

- Experience with firearms, military history, outdoors, or tactical channels

- Experience marketing experience-based or tourism businesses (reaction videos, "first time" content, bucket-list experiences)

- Knowledge of YouTube's firearms content policies and how to keep a channel in good standing

- Experience with construction, home improvement, or real estate content

- Familiarity with vidIQ or TubeBuddy

**Schedule**

- We are in the **U.S. Central Time Zone**. We ask for **2 – 4 hours of overlap** with our business hours for check-ins and collaboration; the rest of your schedule is flexible.



**Why Work With Us**

- Long-term, stable, full-time role with two growing businesses

- A brand-new channel you get to shape from day one – your work will be highly visible

- A large library of existing footage, so you are not starting from nothing

---

title: Full-Time Social Media Manager & Content Operations
description:
Background



We’re a fast-growing short-form content agency managing multiple social media accounts across Instagram,
, TikTok, Threads, YouTube, and more. WE’RE SCALING FAST!!



We’re looking for someone to take ownership of the backend of our content operation - managing accounts, publishing content, maintaining quality, tracking performance, finding inspiration, and solving whatever bottlenecks are slowing the team down.



This is NOT just a posting role. We want someone who is proactive, hungry to improve, and wants to grow with the team long term.



What You'll Do



Social Media Management





- Create and set up Instagram,
, TikTok, Threads, and YouTube accounts

- Warm up new accounts and maintain healthy account activity

- Manage as many social media accounts as possible across multiple clients

- Manually publish content during EST working hours

- Make sure captions, videos, profiles, links, and account information are correct and up to date

- Monitor account health and flag issues immediately



Content Quality & Operations





- Review videos before they are posted and make sure they meet our standards

- Stay on top of editors and their assets to ensure quality and deadlines are being met

- Catch mistakes before content goes live

- Identify bottlenecks across the team and help solve them

- Keep assets, posting schedules, and accounts organized



Performance & Research





- Track the performance of all accounts and report key results back to the team

- Identify what content is performing and what needs improvement

- Scroll TikTok, Instagram,
, YouTube, Reddit, etc. to find new ideas and inspiration

- Find strong hooks, formats, trends, competitors, and content for editors and scriptwriters

- Continuously look for ways to improve our content and operations



Requirements



Must-Haves





- GROWTH MINDSET AND GENUINE HUNGER TO LEARN!!

- Strong English Proficiency (speaking, reading, writing)

- Extremely reliable and organized

- Strong attention to detail

- Comfortable managing many social media accounts at once

- Very familiar with Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, and other social platforms

- Able to work consistently during EST hours

- Comfortable manually posting content every day

- Able to identify problems and solve them without always waiting for instructions

- Comfortable giving feedback and holding team members accountable for quality

- Strong understanding of short-form social media content

- Reliable laptop/computer and internet connection

- Looking for a long-term role and willing to grow with the company



Nice-to-Haves





- Previous social media management experience

- Experience managing multiple client accounts

- Agency or content production experience

- Experience creating and warming up social media accounts

- Understanding of short-form performance, hooks, retention, and trends

- Experience managing editors, creators, or other team members

- Familiarity with Google Drive, Google Sheets, Slack, and project management tools



What We Offer





- Stable, full-time remote role

- Direct access to the team and fast feedback

- Training on our accounts, content standards, and workflows

- Opportunity to take on more responsibility as we scale

- Performance bonuses of up to 40% of monthly pay

- Access to required tools

- Long-term growth opportunities within the company



How to Apply



INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE REVIEWED.

- Start your application with the word “GROWTH”

- Tell us about any social media accounts you've previously managed

- Tell us how many accounts you would feel comfortable managing at once

- What are your available working hours in EST?

- What social platforms are you most experienced with?

- What other clients do you work for?



- Short answer (3-5 sentences): If you noticed an editor repeatedly submitting low-quality videos that were delaying posting, what would you do?

- Short answer (3-5 sentences): How would you make sure dozens of accounts and daily posts stay organized without anything being missed?

- Confirm that you have a reliable laptop/computer and internet connection (with pictures)



We're not looking for someone who waits around for instructions. We want someone who sees a problem, takes ownership of it, and helps the entire team run better.

title: Virtual Reservationist / Guest Services
description:
Virtual Reservationist / Guest Services



We are looking for an experienced Virtual Reservationist to join our hospitality operations team. This is a remote, guest-facing position with a strong focus on phone communication, reservations, and providing excellent service throughout the guest experience.



This is primarily a phone-based role. The ideal candidate is comfortable handling a high volume of inbound and outbound calls, speaking confidently with guests, answering property and reservation questions, and resolving issues professionally.



Responsibilities include:



* Answer inbound guest and reservation calls promptly and professionally

* Assist guests with new reservations, availability, rates, and property questions

* Modify existing reservations and assist with reservation-related requests

* Handle guest questions before, during, and after their stay

* Respond to guest text messages and online communications as needed

* Document guest conversations and follow-up needs accurately

* Coordinate maintenance and operational issues through Breezeway

* Work within Guesty to manage reservations and guest communication

* Escalate urgent or complex situations appropriately

* Follow established procedures while using good judgment to resolve guest concerns



Qualifications:



* Strong phone and customer service experience is required

* Experience with Guesty is strongly preferred

* Experience with Breezeway is strongly preferred

* Previous hospitality, vacation rental, hotel, or reservation experience preferred

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Confident, friendly, and professional phone presence

* Strong attention to detail and ability to document conversations accurately

* Comfortable working in multiple systems while actively speaking with guests

* Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional work environment

* Dependable and able to work independently in a remote environment



We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys talking with guests and understands that answering the phone is a primary responsibility of this position. You should be comfortable moving between Guesty, Breezeway, phone/text systems, and other operational tools while providing a consistent and helpful guest experience.



Position: Virtual Reservationist / Guest Services

Location: Remote

Primary Focus: Phone Reservations & Guest Support
