title: Screening & Sales Operations Manager
description:
**PLEASE UPLOAD A VIDEO RECORDING WITH YOUR APPLICATION**



Are you a highly driven BPO leader with a proven track record of transforming outbound callers into top-tier sales machines? We are a fast-growing door-to-door (D2D) recruiting company actively scaling our international operations. We are looking for a dynamic Screening & Sales Operations Manager to take the helm of our fully remote outbound screening team.

In this high-impact role, you will be the operational engine and lead sales coach for a dedicated team of international screeners. By taking ownership of daily KPIs, team performance, and script optimization, you will empower our Director of Production to focus on high-level client retention and growth strategies. If you are obsessed with process ownership, thrive on coaching outbound SDRs to break conversion records, and want to lead a highly motivated remote team, this is your next career move.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

Daily Operations & Process Ownership: Lead the day-to-day activities of a high-volume international screening team, ensuring all operational SLAs and outbound targets are consistently met.

KPI & Data Management: Track, analyze, and report on daily/weekly team KPIs (call volume, connect rates, screening completion, etc.) to the Director of Production.

Shift & Attendance Management: Oversee shift coverage, schedule adherence, and attendance, ensuring seamless operations across all working hours.

Quality Assurance (QA): Implement and manage a rigorous call auditing process to ensure all screeners maintain high standards of professionalism and compliance.

Sales & Script Coaching

Active Call Coaching: Regularly review live and recorded phone screens, providing immediate, actionable feedback to improve screener performance.

Script & Pitch Optimization: Continuously refine and A/B test pitch frameworks to maximize engagement from cold and warm leads.

Objection Handling Mastery: Train and drill screeners on advanced objection handling techniques specific to recruiting for Door-to-Door (D2D) sales opportunities.

Conversion Optimization: Bridge the gap between operations and sales by actively working to improve the conversion rate of screened candidates to actual D2D job placements.

Requirements & Qualifications

Experience: 4+ years of BPO/Call Center Management experience, with a specific focus on overseeing SDRs, appointment setters, or outbound sales teams.

Sales Acumen: Deep understanding of outbound sales psychology, lead generation, and pitch delivery. (Prior experience in recruiting or D2D sales is a massive plus).

Leadership Skills: Proven ability to manage, motivate, and retain remote teams, holding them accountable to strict performance metrics while fostering a positive, growth-oriented culture.

Communication: Exceptional, near-native English fluency (both written and verbal) with the ability to clearly communicate complex sales concepts.

Technical & Workspace Requirements:

A quiet, distraction-free home office setup.

Reliable, high-speed primary internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps) with a guaranteed backup connection.

Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or backup generator to ensure zero downtime during power outages.

Key Success Metrics (KPIs) - Your First 90 Days

To ensure you are on track for success, your performance in the first 90 days will be measured by:

Candidate Conversion Rates: Measurable increase in the percentage of leads successfully screened and converted into qualified D2D sales reps.

Call Quality & QA Scores: Elevating the team’s average QA scores through consistent auditing and active coaching.

Team Retention & Morale: Maintaining low turnover within the screening team while building a high-performance, supportive culture.

Operational Consistency: Achieving 95%+ SLA compliance for daily shift coverage and scheduled call volume.

Compensation & Perks

Highly Competitive Salary: $1,500 – $2,000 USD per month (depending on experience).

True Remote Flexibility: 100% work-from-home setup, allowing you to work from anywhere in the Philippines.

Career Trajectory: Get in on the ground floor of a rapidly scaling department, with direct access to executive leadership and clear paths for future promotion.

title: CLINICAL COORDINATOR — PHARMACY & PATIENT ENGAGEMENT
description:
Journey Psyche LLC | Remote



Journey Psyche is a growing multi-state psychiatric and telepsychiatry practice seeking an experienced Clinical Coordinator to support our providers and patients.



We are particularly interested in candidates with a pharmacy or pharmaceutical background, including candidates with a pharmacy degree or significant pharmacy experience, who also have excellent patient-engagement and customer-service skills.



This is a highly patient-facing position. We are looking for someone who is compassionate, organized, responsive and comfortable communicating with patients throughout their care.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Serve as a primary point of contact for existing patients

• Assist patients with medication and prescription-related communications

• Coordinate refill requests between patients, pharmacies and licensed providers

• Follow up on pharmacy issues and prescription status

• Assist with prior-authorization and medication-related administrative workflows

• Identify patients who need follow-up appointments and coordinate scheduling

• Monitor patient messages and ensure issues are routed to the correct clinical provider

• Proactively contact patients who need appointments, documentation or follow-up

• Help prevent patients from falling out of care

• Support new-patient and existing-patient engagement as needed

• Communicate professionally with pharmacies, providers and patients

• Document patient communications accurately in company systems

• Work closely with Journey Psyche’s providers, scheduling team and clinical leadership

• Provide exceptional customer service during every patient interaction



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Preferred backgrounds include:



• Pharmacist or pharmacy-degree background

• Pharmacy technician or pharmaceutical experience

• Healthcare patient engagement

• Behavioral health or psychiatric practice experience

• Medical-office or clinical-coordination experience

• Hospital or healthcare customer service



A pharmacy degree or pharmacy experience is strongly preferred, but we will consider exceptional candidates with substantial healthcare and patient-engagement experience.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



You are someone who:



• Genuinely enjoys helping patients

• Has excellent written and verbal English communication

• Understands medications and pharmacy terminology

• Is comfortable communicating with pharmacies and healthcare professionals

• Can handle a high volume of patient communication

• Is extremely organized and follows through

• Takes ownership instead of waiting to be reminded

• Is comfortable learning healthcare technology and multiple systems

• Understands patient privacy and confidentiality

• Can work independently in a fast-moving remote environment



IMPORTANT CLINICAL BOUNDARY



This is a clinical-coordination and patient-engagement position. Clinical Coordinators do not independently diagnose, prescribe, change medications or make treatment decisions. All clinical decisions remain with Journey Psyche’s appropriately licensed providers.



ABOUT JOURNEY PSYCHE



Journey Psyche is a growing psychiatric and telepsychiatry organization providing medication management and behavioral-health services across multiple states.



Our model combines experienced psychiatric providers with strong patient engagement, clinical coordination and technology to make psychiatric care more accessible and responsive.



We are continuing to add providers and expand our patient population, creating an opportunity for the right Clinical Coordinator to grow with the organization.



KEYWORDS FOR POSTING / RECRUITING



Primary keywords:

Pharmacist | Pharmacy | Clinical Coordinator



Additional keywords:

Patient Engagement | Customer Service | Patient Care | Medication Management Support | Prescription Coordination | Pharmacy Support | Behavioral Health | Healthcare | Telehealth | Medical Coordinator

title: AI UGC Video Editor (Google VEO Flow + CapCut) - 7 videos/day, long-term
description:
I'm looking for someone who ALREADY knows how to make AI UGC videos, not someone who wants to learn from scratch.



I've attached an example video. This is exactly the style and quality level I need. Watch it before you apply.



THE WORKLOAD

7 finished product videos per day, each 1 to 2 minutes long. That's the job. It's real volume and I want you to know that before you apply.



It's doable because the process is systemized. I send you the script, the reference video, the character reference image and the exact prompts the day before, so you have the full day to work. You're not inventing anything from scratch.



Week 1 is 5 to 6 a day while I audit your workflow with you and help you get faster. After that it's 7.



If you can only do 3 to 4 a day at good quality, tell me honestly in your application. I'd rather know now than find out in week two.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Generating AI avatars / AI characters that talk (Google VEO Flow)

- Assembling everything in CapCut: cuts, captions, timing, subtle background music

- Recreating a reference video closely while swapping in my avatar, my pet, my product and my setting

- Checking every clip before it goes in, no broken generations, no bad lip sync

- Exporting vertical 9:16, 1080x1920 MP4 and uploading them one by one as you finish



THE 8 THINGS I GET TIRED OF FIXING

This is the real job description. These are the notes I end up sending editors over and over. If you already do these without being told, you will do very well here.



1. Character consistency. Every video has a character reference image. The face, the outfit, the pet and the setting stay the same across every clip and across every video that character appears in. Don't redesign the character, don't let the face drift between clips.



2. Voice consistency. One voice start to finish. No echo, no reverb, no accent that shows up halfway through the video and disappears again. Rewatch the whole thing with headphones before you send it. If one scene has an accent or an echo, regenerate that scene.



3. Lip sync. If it's off by half a second, regenerate it. I notice.



4. Captions. Always on, clean, synced and styled like the reference video. "Missing captions" should never be a note I have to send you.



5. Background music. Subtle, sitting under the voice, matching the reference, and stopping where the reference stops it. Not missing, not blasting over the dialogue.



6. Match the reference. When I say copy it 1 to 1, I mean the framing, the pacing, the energy and the shot order. The avatar should fill the frame the way the reference does, not sit small in the middle. Natural phone footage look, not a cinematic color grade. And use MY background and setting, not the one from the inspo video.



7. Export quality. Download 720p from Flow, export from CapCut with the settings I give you, vertical 9:16 1080x1920. No blurry clips, no clips where the quality obviously jumps mid-video, no watermarks.



8. Revisions get done the same day. When I send a fix, it gets fixed that day, it doesn't get stacked onto next week. Keep your Flow generations and your CapCut project file so a small fix stays a small fix instead of a full rebuild.



FLOW CREDIT DISCIPLINE (matters as much as the editing)

- Images cost 0 credits. Perfect the image first, then generate the video.

- One clip generation per scene. Never x2, x3 or x4.

- Never 16:9. Everything is vertical.

- Every video generation costs credits whether it comes out good or bad. There are no refunds for a bad clip, so the prompt has to be right before you hit generate.

- Screenshot the credit balance when you start and when you finish each assignment.



I provide the accounts and the credits. Burning through them carelessly is the fastest way off the team.



REQUIREMENTS (please read, I skip applications that ignore this)

1. You MUST send me examples of AI videos you've personally made. Links to the actual videos, not a resume, not a portfolio site with stock work. If you've made something close to my example video, lead with that one.



2. Be ready to prove the work is yours. I get sent the same recycled portfolio folders by different people every week. I may ask for a bigger folder from that client, a project file, or a short screen recording of your workflow. If you can't show that, don't apply.



3. Real CapCut experience. Captions, keyframes, audio ducking, speed ramps, without me explaining them.



4. Hands-on experience with at least one AI video tool (Google VEO / Flow, Kling, Higgsfield, HeyGen, Sora, etc). Tell me which ones and what you used them for.

.

description:
Journey Psyche LLC | Remote



Journey Psyche is a growing multi-state psychiatric and telepsychiatry practice seeking an experienced Clinical Coordinator to support our providers and patients.



We are particularly interested in candidates with a pharmacy or pharmaceutical background, including candidates with a pharmacy degree or significant pharmacy experience, who also have excellent patient-engagement and customer-service skills.



This is a highly patient-facing position. We are looking for someone who is compassionate, organized, responsive and comfortable communicating with patients throughout their care.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Serve as a primary point of contact for existing patients

• Assist patients with medication and prescription-related communications

• Coordinate refill requests between patients, pharmacies and licensed providers

• Follow up on pharmacy issues and prescription status

• Assist with prior-authorization and medication-related administrative workflows

• Identify patients who need follow-up appointments and coordinate scheduling

• Monitor patient messages and ensure issues are routed to the correct clinical provider

• Proactively contact patients who need appointments, documentation or follow-up

• Help prevent patients from falling out of care

• Support new-patient and existing-patient engagement as needed

• Communicate professionally with pharmacies, providers and patients

• Document patient communications accurately in company systems

• Work closely with Journey Psyche’s providers, scheduling team and clinical leadership

• Provide exceptional customer service during every patient interaction



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Preferred backgrounds include:



• Pharmacist or pharmacy-degree background

• Pharmacy technician or pharmaceutical experience

• Healthcare patient engagement

• Behavioral health or psychiatric practice experience

• Medical-office or clinical-coordination experience

• Hospital or healthcare customer service



A pharmacy degree or pharmacy experience is strongly preferred, but we will consider exceptional candidates with substantial healthcare and patient-engagement experience.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



You are someone who:



• Genuinely enjoys helping patients

• Has excellent written and verbal English communication

• Understands medications and pharmacy terminology

• Is comfortable communicating with pharmacies and healthcare professionals

• Can handle a high volume of patient communication

• Is extremely organized and follows through

• Takes ownership instead of waiting to be reminded

• Is comfortable learning healthcare technology and multiple systems

• Understands patient privacy and confidentiality

• Can work independently in a fast-moving remote environment



IMPORTANT CLINICAL BOUNDARY



This is a clinical-coordination and patient-engagement position. Clinical Coordinators do not independently diagnose, prescribe, change medications or make treatment decisions. All clinical decisions remain with Journey Psyche’s appropriately licensed providers.



ABOUT JOURNEY PSYCHE



Journey Psyche is a growing psychiatric and telepsychiatry organization providing medication management and behavioral-health services across multiple states.



Our model combines experienced psychiatric providers with strong patient engagement, clinical coordination and technology to make psychiatric care more accessible and responsive.



We are continuing to add providers and expand our patient population, creating an opportunity for the right Clinical Coordinator to grow with the organization.

Working hours



9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)

2+ years in B2B sales or outbound cold calling.

Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.

What you're walking into



A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You'll know exactly what's expected, exactly what you'll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.

title: AI Affiliate UGC Creator & Cross-Platform Content VA
description:
# AI Affiliate UGC Creator & Cross-Platform Content VA



**Location:** Philippines — Remote

**Position:** Part-time to start, with potential for full-time

**Pay:** to be discuss depending on experience

**Schedule:** Flexible, but consistent daily production is required



## About the Role



I am building a faceless affiliate marketing business focused on **AI-generated UGC-style short-form videos**.



The goal is to create engaging product videos and distribute them across multiple social media platforms.



You will use **Claude + Higgsfield** as the primary AI content-production system.



You will be responsible for the complete workflow:



**Product → Research → Script → AI UGC Video → Edit → Publish → Track Results**



This is NOT a basic social media posting job.



I am looking for someone who can create the content AND distribute it.



---



## Reference Videos



Please watch these videos carefully before applying. They demonstrate the type of AI affiliate/UGC content workflow we want to build.



**Reference #1 — AI Affiliate Marketing with Claude + Higgsfield:**





**Reference #2 — AI Affiliate Marketing / Claude + AI Video Workflow:**





**Important:** You should understand the workflow and concept demonstrated in these videos before applying.



---



# Your Responsibilities



## 1. Product Research



For products selected for promotion:



* Research the product.

* Understand the target customer.

* Identify the problem the product solves.

* Identify the strongest benefits.

* Research competing products/content.

* Find interesting content angles.

* Suggest different ways to present the product in UGC format.



You do not need to independently choose every affiliate product. Product selection will be part of the overall strategy.



---



# 2. Create UGC Concepts Using Claude



Use **Claude** to create:



* UGC concepts

* Strong hooks

* Short scripts

* Different storytelling angles

* Product demonstrations

* Problem/solution concepts

* Testimonial-style concepts

* Gift ideas

* Comparison concepts

* Calls to action



The content should feel like **organic social media content**, not a traditional commercial.



For each product, we may test multiple hooks and angles.



---



# 3. Create AI UGC Videos Using Higgsfield



Use **Higgsfield** to turn the approved concept/script into a finished AI UGC-style video.



Videos may include:



* AI UGC creators

* Product demonstrations

* Product close-ups

* Lifestyle scenes

* Talking-head style content

* Voice/audio

* Captions

* Social-media-style presentation



The goal is to create videos that look natural and are designed to **stop the scroll and generate clicks**.



You should become very comfortable using the **Claude + Higgsfield workflow**.



---



# 4. Final Video Editing



Use CapCut or another appropriate editor when necessary to:



* Improve pacing

* Add/edit captions

* Add music/audio

* Add CTA

* Correct obvious AI problems

* Format the video correctly

* Make the final video ready for publishing



Most videos will be approximately **15–30 seconds**, depending on the concept.



---



# 5. Cross-Platform Publishing



You will publish the finished videos across:



* TikTok

* Instagram Reels

* YouTube Shorts

*
 Reels

* Pinterest



You will handle:



* Uploading

* Captions

* Hashtags where appropriate

* CTAs

* Affiliate disclosures

* Affiliate links/product tags where available

* Scheduling

* Organizing published content



One video may be adapted for multiple platforms when appropriate.



---



# 6. Track Performance



Maintain a simple content tracking spreadsheet.



Track:



* Product

* Video

* Hook

* Platform

* Date posted

* Views

* Engagement

* Link clicks

* Sales/conversions when available

* Commission



The purpose is to identify:



**Which products work?**



**Which hooks work?**



**Which videos generate clicks?**



**Which videos generate sales?**



When we find a winner, you will create additional variations around that winning concept.



---



# Production Target



Initial target:



### 3 original AI UGC videos per day



Approximately:



### 15 original videos per week



Each video can then be distributed across multiple platforms.



As you become faster and the system improves, the production target may increase.



**Quality and performance are more important than simply producing a large number of videos.**



---



# Required Skills



You should have experience with:



* TikTok

* Instagram Reels

* YouTube Shorts

*
 Reels

* Short-form video

* CapCut or similar editing software

* AI tools

* Claude

* AI video generation

* Basic affiliate marketing



### Strongly preferred:



Experience with **Higgsfield** and AI-generated UGC.



You do NOT need to know every AI tool on the market.



Our primary workflow will be:



### Claude + Higgsfield + CapCut



---



# What I Am Looking For



I want someone who can work independently.



You should be able to take a product and think:



> "What would make someone stop scrolling?"



You should understand:



**Hook → Problem → Product → Benefit → CTA**



You should also understand that a good-looking AI video is not necessarily a good marketing video.



The goal is:



### Attention → Interest → Click → Sale



---



# Important



This position is NOT simply:



"Make videos."



And it is NOT simply:



"Post videos."



You will own the entire content workflow.



**Research → Claude → Higgsfield → Edit → Publish → Track**



I will provide the overall business strategy, affiliate offers/products, accounts, and direction.



You will execute the content operation.



---



# Trial Assignment



Before hiring, shortlisted candidates will receive one affiliate product.



You will be asked to:



1. Research the product.

2. Identify the target customer.

3. Create 3 different hooks using Claude.

4. Create one short UGC script.

5. Create an AI UGC video using Higgsfield.

6. Edit the final video if necessary.

7. Write the caption and CTA.

8. Prepare the video for cross-platform publishing.

9. Explain why you chose your particular hook and UGC angle.



### The trial video should follow the general style demonstrated in the reference videos above.



---



# How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your name

2. Location in the Philippines

3. Monthly salary expectation

4. Your experience with affiliate marketing

5. Your experience creating TikTok/Reels/Shorts

6. Your experience with Claude

7. Your experience with Higgsfield

8. Your experience with AI-generated UGC

9. Your experience with CapCut

10. Links to 3–5 short-form videos you have created



### Also answer these questions:



**1. Have you watched both reference videos above?**



**2. What do you understand about the affiliate content strategy demonstrated in the videos?**



**3. If I give you a product, how would you use Claude to create a UGC concept that makes people want to click?**



**4. Can you create the video yourself using Claude + Higgsfield without needing step-by-step instructions?**



**5. Can you publish and manage the same content across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts,
 and 
?**



I am looking for someone who wants to operate a **long-term AI-powered affiliate content machine**, not someone looking for simple data-entry or video-upload work.

title: Media Buyer (Google Ads + Meta Ads)
description:
This is Us

Sona Visual is a content creation and marketing team based in Calgary, Canada, with a growing footprint in Canada and US. For over a decade we've built a name for ourselves in real estate marketing, and we're now expanding what we do for our clients beyond photography and video into full-funnel digital marketing, including paid ads.

We move fast, we're hands-on, and we care about getting real results for our clients, not just clicks and impressions. If you like owning something end to end and seeing your work turn directly into leads and revenue for real businesses, keep reading.



The Role

We're hiring an in-house Media Buyer to become our go-to expert on Google Ads, Meta Ads, and paid advertising more broadly. This isn't a "run a few campaigns and check back in a month" role. You'll be managing live ad accounts for real clients (real estate agents and brokerages, home builders, renovation companies, and home services businesses), and for Sona Visual itself, with real budgets and real accountability for cost per lead and return on ad spend.



Over time, this role is meant to grow into the person our whole team and our clients go to for paid media strategy, not just execution.



What You'll Own

• Build, launch, and manage Google Ads campaigns (Search, Performance Max, Local Services Ads where applicable) and Meta Ads campaigns 
 and Instagram) for multiple client accounts at once

• Handle campaign structure, keyword and audience targeting, ad copy and creative direction, budget pacing, and bid strategy

• Track and report on cost per lead, cost per acquisition, and ROAS, and translate that into plain-English recommendations for clients and for our internal team

• Set up and maintain conversion tracking (Google Tag Manager, call tracking, form submissions, Meta Pixel/Conversions API) so the numbers we report are numbers we can trust

• Stay on top of platform changes across Google, Meta, and other ad platforms (TikTok, LinkedIn, Microsoft Ads) and bring in new channels when they make sense for a client

• Collaborate with our SEO, content, and account management team so paid and organic efforts are pulling in the same direction

• Flag underperforming campaigns early and pitch the fix, rather than waiting to be asked



A Bit About You

You've run paid ad campaigns with your own hands, not just watched someone else do it. You know the difference between a campaign that looks fine and a campaign that's actually making money, and you're comfortable saying so even when the answer isn't what a client wants to hear.



You're organized enough to manage several ad accounts at once without letting any of them go stale, and curious enough that you're already testing new features and formats before your clients ask about them.



Qualifications

• Proven, hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns with real budgets (please be ready to walk us through actual account results or a portfolio, screenshots and anonymized case studies are fine)

• Solid understanding of conversion tracking and attribution: Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Meta Pixel/CAPI, call tracking

• Experience with, or strong working knowledge of, real estate, home building, renovations, or home services marketing (this industry's ad strategy is different from ecommerce or SaaS, and we need someone who already gets that)

• Comfortable with reporting and dashboards (Looker Studio or similar) and can explain performance in terms a business owner cares about, not just platform jargon

• Strong written English for ad copy and client-facing reporting

• Reliable internet, a proper work setup, and the discipline to manage your own time as a fully remote team member

Nice to Have (Bonus Points)

• Agency experience, where you were juggling multiple client accounts and multiple industries at once

• Experience with GoHighLevel or another CRM/marketing automation platform

• Experience with Local Services Ads or other real-estate and home-services-specific ad products

• Basic comfort in WordPress (our clients' sites run on it)

• A track record of scaling a campaign's budget while holding or improving ROAS, not just spending more



Compensation & Schedule

• Full-time, remote position

• Pay: $800 to $1,200 USD/month, based on experience and demonstrated results

• Schedule: Monday to Friday, with at least a few hours of overlap with Calgary, Canada business hours (Mountain Time, UTC-7/-6)

• This is meant to be a long-term seat on our team, not a short-term contract; we're looking to invest in whoever takes this role as our in-house paid media expert



How to Apply

Please apply with:

• Your resume

• A short note on your Google Ads and Meta Ads experience, including which industries you've worked in and roughly what budgets you've managed

• Any portfolio, case studies, or anonymized account screenshots that show real campaign results (this matters more to us than certifications)

• To confirm you read this whole posting, please start your application with the words "Ready to Buy" in the subject line



We review every application personally, so take the time to show us real work rather than a generic template.

Analysis and improvement

- Analyze refund/return data every month: top reasons, problem products, costs, and trends

- Identify products that get many complaints and bring them to management with a clear recommendation

- Suggest improvements to our macros, size charts, product descriptions and processes



What we require

- 1+ year of
 customer support experience in Shopify fashion dropshipping.

What do we value?

- Results first! If something needs to be done, we make it happen.

- Open communication. If we have a problem, we talk. If we have an idea, we discuss it. If we learn something new, we document it!

- The customer's experience is our reputation. Every reply matters.

title: Customer Service & Store Operations Assistant - True Gear
description:
True Gear is a small Australian ecommerce business selling adventure gear. Have a look at what we sell at 
. It's a genuinely small operation, just the owner and one part-time sales rep, no layers of management and no corporate red tape.



The role



We're after someone based in the Philippines to be the main point of contact for our customers, and to help keep the operational and admin side of the store running. This isn't a script-reading support job, but you also don't need deep product knowledge to start. Anyone who's ready to buy or wants sales advice gets forwarded straight to our sales rep, that side stays separate. We'll grow your product knowledge over time as it becomes useful, and we may end up keeping sales and support fully separate long-term rather than expecting one person to do both.



It's a genuinely small team: you, the owner, and one part-time sales rep. Most days you'll be working directly alongside the owner, not buried under layers of management.



Customer service is the core of the role and where most of your week goes. Alongside it, there's some simple admin: tracking numbers and shipments, keeping the inbox organised, basic bookkeeping and invoicing, and other small ongoing tasks as they come up. Nothing here needs a specialist skillset, it's work that needs doing between customer conversations.



What you'll actually be doing

Answering customer enquiries by
, SMS and phone, first point of contact for everything post-purchase and for quick pre-purchase questions

Forwarding anyone ready to buy, or after sales advice, straight to our sales rep, closing the sale isn't your job

Managing tracking numbers and shipments: chasing couriers, keeping customers updated, sorting out delivery issues

Investigating whatever a customer needs looked into (order status, stock, a supplier query) and getting the answer back to them yourself

Handling the store's day-to-day inbox, keeping it organised and on top of things

Basic bookkeeping and invoicing

General admin as it comes up

What we're looking for



Three things matter most, everything else is a bonus:



Takes feedback well. Because it's such a small team, you'll get honest, direct feedback fairly often, especially while you're learning the ropes in the first few weeks. We genuinely care how you're doing, it's not about catching you out, it's about helping you get better quickly. We're after someone who can take that feedback on board and keep moving forward with it.

Strong work ethic. Able to work independently once you know the systems, without needing to be watched or chased. You'll be trained on our tools (Trello, Slack, Gmail, Shopify), but this isn't a role for someone who needs constant supervision.

Great communication. Clear, well-spoken English is a big plus, you'll be talking to Australian customers directly. Natural over scripted. Calm and honest, if you don't know something, it's fine to say so and follow up.



Nice to have, not required:



Comfortable in Shopify, or a fast learner who's used similar platforms

Knowledge about electricity and power

Experience with freight or courier coordination



You don't need to arrive already knowing the products. That's something you'll pick up on the job, not a day-one requirement.



Why work with us

It's a small business, not a corporation. There are guidelines and structure, but we're reasonable and friendly, and can accommodate things when they come up.

This isn't a high-pressure or overly stressful role.

You'll have an integrated Claude AI agent set up to help you work through tasks efficiently, and a Claude Pro subscription is included as part of the role.

One paid day off per month, and unpaid leave can be accommodated when you need it.

Hours and pay

9am to 5pm, Monday to Friday, Melbourne time (transitions between AEST and AEDT through the year), with a one-hour lunch break

AUD $1,020 per month, paid fortnightly

Commission structure available after the trial period: up to an extra $300 per month in bonuses, with standard commission around $100 per month tied to business and/or personal performancc

Independent contractor role

Hours are logged with time-tracking software for the whole shift, standard for this kind of role



If you've read this far, start your application message with the word "Tracked". We get a lot of applications for roles like this, and it's the fastest way to tell us you've read the whole posting rather than just the title.



Trial period and ongoing terms



Three month trial period, either party can end the arrangement without cause during this time. After that, the agreement rolls monthly with one month's written notice either way. Contractor is responsible for their own tax and insurance, standard for an independent contractor arrangement.

ABOUT BOOSTED COMMERCE



Boosted Commerce (founded in 2019) is a digitally-native, CPG platform focused on acquiring and building new, fast-growing beauty, health, and wellness brands. We are a seasoned team of traditional retail and ecommerce operators already scaling several consumer brands with proven product-market fit.



As we expand our operations, we are looking for a highly motivated Senior Accountant to join our accounting team and help us build robust, scalable accounting practices that support our continued growth.



Position Summary



The Senior Accountant will play a key role in managing weekly and month-end accounting operations related to sales audit, payment reconciliation, cash applications, multi-currency transactions, inventory management, and sales tax. This position requires strong experience working with eCommerce platforms and high transaction volumes, along with excellent problem-solving, process improvement, analytical, and organizational skills.



You will work closely with the Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, and Customer Service teams to ensure financial accuracy, timely reporting, and operational efficiency.



Key Responsibilities

Perform and support the monthly close process for Revenue, Cash, AR, Inventory & COGS, and Prepaid accounts.

Prepare and maintain supporting documentation, reconciliations, and internal controls to ensure accuracy and support audit and compliance requirements.

Audit and reconcile sales transactions across Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, and other eCommerce platforms. Investigate and resolve variances, missing transactions, and sales invoices.

Reconcile cash receipts and AR balances across multiple payment platforms, including Amazon, Shopify, Payoneer, PayPal, Stripe, and other payment providers, as well as the accounting ERP system.

Investigate and resolve GL discrepancies and reconciling items in a timely manner.

Support inventory accounting and reconciliations, including inventory adjustments, inventory in transit, and prepaid inventory.

Partner with the Supply Chain team to investigate and resolve inventory and COGS variances.

Prepare and support monthly reporting and analysis related to Amazon operating expenses, Shopify sales tax, and other financial activities.

Support various ad hoc accounting and financial analysis projects as needed.

Identify opportunities to improve and streamline billing, reconciliation, reporting, and accounting processes.

Recommend and implement process improvements that increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.



Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

5+ years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in an eCommerce, DTC, consumer goods, or high-volume transaction environment.

Strong understanding of GAAP and the month-end close process.

Demonstrated experience preparing balance sheet reconciliations, supporting schedules, and financial analyses, including resolving complex reconciling items.

CPA or CPA candidate preferred.

Strong hands-on experience reconciling multi-channel sales and payment gateways and analyzing detailed transaction reports from platforms such as Amazon Seller Central, Shopify, and TikTok Shop.

Strong experience with ERP systems, with NetSuite highly preferred.

Experience supporting or participating in accounting system implementations, process improvements, or other operational projects.

Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced remote environment.

Excellent communication skills and strong attention to detail.

About the Role



We are an established pet supplies e-commerce company looking for a hands-on E-Commerce Operations Manager to own and grow our Shopify store.



This is not primarily a delegation or team-coordination role. You will personally manage the day-to-day store, analyze performance, improve conversion, create campaigns and content, handle customer inquiries, maintain inventory accuracy, and continuously look for ways to increase revenue and profitability.



You will report to the General Manager and work with a small remote team, including a Graphic Designer and external marketing partners.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Shopify & E-Commerce Growth

* Own the day-to-day management of our Shopify store.

* Manage products, collections, merchandising, pricing, inventory, promotions, apps, and website content.

* Monitor and improve revenue, conversion rate, AOV, engagement, and other key e-commerce metrics.

* Identify CRO opportunities and improve product pages, navigation, landing pages, offers, and onsite messaging.

* Recommend promotions and other initiatives to grow profitable sales.

* Proactively identify and fix website issues rather than waiting for them to be assigned.



2. Email, Content & SEO

* Plan, write, build, and schedule email/newsletter campaigns.

* Write and improve product descriptions, landing pages, collection copy, and promotional content.

* Perform keyword research and on-page SEO.

* Create, refresh, and fact-check AI-assisted blog content.

* Develop enough product knowledge to create accurate content and confidently research information when needed.



3. Analytics & Reporting

* Analyze Shopify and GA4 performance and explain why results are changing.

* Maintain a weekly e-commerce performance scorecard.

* To confirm that you read the entire listing, include your favorite cartoon cat in the first sentence of your cover letter.

* Prepare basic profitability reports covering revenue, COGS, shipping, ad spend, discounts, and other major expenses.

* Understand Google Ads reporting well enough to evaluate paid traffic and collaborate with our advertising agency.

* Turn data into specific recommendations and actions.



4. Customer Service & Operations

* Personally handle our relatively low volume of customer inquiries.

* Process orders with dropshipping suppliers according to existing SOPs.

* Ensure orders are sent accurately and on time.

* Maintain accurate inventory availability and pricing.

* Follow through on issues until they are actually resolved.



This Is a Hands-On Role



Although this is a manager-level position, we are a small company and expect this person to be comfortable doing the work, not simply delegating it.



If a newsletter needs to be built, you should be able to build it. If an image needs a simple resize, you should be able to resize it. If product copy needs improvement, you should be able to rewrite it. If an app isn't working, you should investigate the problem and look for a solution or workaround. Routine execution is part of this role.



What We're Looking For:

* 5+ years of relevant e-commerce experience preferred, with meaningful hands-on Shopify experience.

* Strong understanding of Shopify, CRO, merchandising, and e-commerce best practices.

You will have meaningful ownership of Shopify performance, including:

* Revenue growth

* Inventory and order accuracy

* Profitability and reporting

title: Marketing Director
description:
About Starbond



Starbond is a growing direct-to-consumer brand specializing in high-quality adhesives and related products. We sell through Shopify, Amazon, and other e-commerce and B2B channels.



We are building a more disciplined, data-driven Marketing function and are looking for a Marketing Director who can turn customer insight, strong execution, and sound unit economics into profitable, scalable growth.



About the Role



The Marketing Director will own the design, performance, and continuous improvement of Starbond’s Marketing function. This leader will establish the strategy, team structure, systems, decision rights, reporting, and cross-functional cadence required to drive profitable growth.



This is not a high-level advisory role. Starbond is still developing its marketing infrastructure, so the Marketing Director must be comfortable moving between strategy and execution. You must be able to personally calculate, validate, and explain the numbers behind marketing performance—not rely solely on dashboards, agencies, or reports prepared by others.



You will oversee DTC growth across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), social media, conversion rate optimization, brand, and agency performance.



Key Responsibilities



Marketing Strategy and Leadership

Set annual and quarterly Marketing strategies, priorities, resource plans, and measurable outcomes.

Build a scalable Marketing operating model with clear workflows, decision rights, quality standards, and accountability.

Assess and improve the team’s structure, capabilities, tools, data, agencies, and cross-functional handoffs.

Develop capable leaders and owners beneath the role so execution does not depend on constant intervention.

Set team KPIs, coaching cadences, performance standards, succession plans, and corrective actions.

Provide the CEO with concise, financially grounded updates on results, risks, constraints, and recommended decisions.



Profitable DTC Growth

Own integrated DTC growth across Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, email, SEO, AEO, social media, content, CRO, and other relevant channels.

Establish acceptable acquisition thresholds by product, channel, campaign, customer segment, and cohort.

Determine when to scale, restructure, reduce, or discontinue marketing investments.

Connect marketing plans with inventory, operational capacity, product readiness, and financial objectives.

Ensure marketing decisions prioritize profitable growth—not revenue or ROAS alone.



Marketing Analytics and Unit Economics

Personally calculate and validate CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, CAC payback, MER, ROAS, gross margin, contribution margin, conversion rates, retention, cohort performance, and other funnel metrics.

Audit formulas, source data, assumptions, attribution methods, and agency reports for accuracy.

Identify incorrect calculations, inconsistent definitions, unsupported assumptions, and material data gaps.

Translate findings into specific decisions involving budgets, channels, campaigns, offers, creative, landing pages, retention, and resource allocation.

Ensure all material recommendations are financially grounded, traceable to source data, and ready for executive decision-making.



Agency and Channel Management

Manage agencies supporting paid media, lifecycle marketing, SEO/AEO, content, creative, and related functions.

Define agency scopes, KPIs, service-level expectations, reporting requirements, ownership, and escalation paths.

Independently validate agency recommendations and hold partners accountable for results and deadlines.

Address underperformance promptly through documented corrective actions.

Ensure Starbond retains ownership and access to advertising accounts, data, dashboards, creative files, documentation, and intellectual property.



Brand, Customer Insight, and Execution

Own customer insight, positioning, messaging architecture, and brand standards.

Govern creative testing, content production, lifecycle campaigns, landing pages, attribution, and conversion optimization.

Ensure campaigns and product launches have clear briefs, readiness checks, QA processes, measurement plans, and post-launch learning reviews.

Remain close enough to execution to inspect work, resolve critical blockers, and improve quality when needed.



Cross-Functional Leadership

Build a consistent planning cadence across Marketing, Product/R&D, Amazon, Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Web Development, HR, and the CEO.

Anticipate inventory, capacity, staffing, technical, and operational constraints before they affect launches or marketing commitments.

Surface risks and difficult issues early, supported by evidence, tradeoffs, and a clear recommendation.

Challenge assumptions constructively and redirect resources when customer or financial evidence supports a different decision.



What We’re Looking For

Proven experience leading a DTC or e-commerce Marketing function with accountability for profitable growth.

Strong hands-on knowledge of paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, CRO, content, SEO, and brand strategy.

Advanced understanding of unit economics, including CAC, LTV, CAC payback, MER, gross margin, contribution margin, retention, and cohort analysis.

Ability to independently recreate, audit, and explain marketing calculations using underlying source data.

Experience managing internal Marketing teams and developing accountable leaders.

Strong experience managing marketing agencies and holding them accountable to defined KPIs, deadlines, and commercial expectations.

Ability to connect marketing performance with profitability, customer quality, retention, inventory, and operational capacity.

Experience building processes and systems within a growing or developing Marketing organization.

Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to clearly present evidence, financial impact, tradeoffs, and recommendations.

Willingness to challenge weak assumptions, confront underperformance, and make difficult decisions.

Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where strategy and hands-on execution are both required.



Tools and Platforms

Experience with several of the following is expected:

Shopify

Meta Ads Manager

Google Ads

Google Analytics 4

Google Search Console

 and lifecycle marketing platforms

Amazon reporting

Looker, Power BI, or similar business intelligence tools

Google Workspace

ClickUp or similar project-management platforms

Agency reporting and attribution systems



What Success Looks Like

Marketing generates profitable DTC revenue and contribution-margin growth.

CAC and CAC payback remain within approved thresholds by channel, product, and cohort.

At least 90% of committed strategic milestones are delivered or formally replanned.

Agencies consistently meet deadlines and receive timely performance reviews and corrective actions.

Core unit-economics and funnel calculations are accurate, consistent, and traceable to source data.

The Marketing function has clear ownership, capable leaders, reliable reporting, and a scalable operating cadence.

Risks, performance misses, and resource constraints are communicated early with recommended actions.



This Role May Not Be the Right Fit If You

Prefer to operate only as a strategist or advisor.

Depend entirely on analysts, agencies, or dashboards to explain marketing performance.

Present revenue or ROAS as proof of success without considering margin, retention, or customer quality.

Avoid challenging agencies, team members, or leadership when the evidence supports a different decision.

Are uncomfortable entering the details, auditing calculations, or personally unblocking critical work.

Require a fully developed marketing infrastructure before you can perform effectively.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and briefly answer the following questions:

Describe a DTC or e-commerce business you helped grow and the results you personally influenced.

Explain how you calculate CAC, LTV, CAC payback, and contribution margin. Include an example of how these metrics influenced a budget or channel decision.

Share an example of a marketing report, dashboard, or agency recommendation you found to be inaccurate. How did you validate the data, and what did you change?

Describe your experience building or restructuring a Marketing team or operating model.

Share an example of how you held an underperforming agency or team accountable.

List the advertising, analytics, e-commerce, lifecycle marketing, and business intelligence platforms you have used.





We are looking for a Marketing Director who can build the function, develop strong owners, confront difficult issues, and stay close enough to the numbers and execution to drive measurable, profitable growth.

title: Video Ad Creator
description:
About us

Solovea is a direct-response e-commerce brand selling health, wellness and beauty products across Europe (Netherlands, Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Sweden, Norway). Our traffic runs on Meta ads, and our funnels follow an advertorial → salespage structure. Video ads are the next lever we're scaling, and we're hiring a dedicated editor to own that output.



The role

You'll turn written product material into finished video ads. For each product you receive an advertorial and a salespage. From those, you produce 1–3 minute video ads by combining AI-generated video, stock footage, screen recordings, product visuals and other online content, with voiceover, captions and on-screen text. Ads are made in multiple languages, so you'll work from translated scripts and AI voiceover rather than filming anything yourself.



What you'll do



Read the advertorial and salespage, extract the hook, story and offer, and build the ad around them

Script and structure 1–3 minute direct-response video ads (hook → problem → mechanism → proof → offer → CTA)

Produce footage using AI video tools (e.g. Seedance, Veo, Runway), stock libraries (e.g. Artlist) and sourced online content

Generate and sync voiceovers in Dutch, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Swedish and Norwegian using AI voice tools (e.g. ElevenLabs)

Add burned-in subtitles, text overlays, sound design and music

Deliver 2–3 variations per ad (different hooks/openers) so we can test

Turn around revisions quickly, sometimes the same day, based on ad performance data

Keep a clean, organised project library so any ad can be re-cut for a new market in hours, not days



Compensation



Base salary: ₱60,000 per month

Commission: 5% of the net profit generated by every ad you produce that becomes profitable. Uncapped. A winning ad can run for months, so this compounds.

Salary increases are on the table and tied to deliverables: volume, hit rate and turnaround.



What we need from you



2+ years editing video ads or short-form marketing video (direct-response, e-commerce or dropshipping experience is a strong plus)

Proven use of AI video and voice tools in real work, not just experiments

Strong sense of pacing and retention: you know why the first 3 seconds matter and how to keep someone watching to the CTA

Comfortable working in languages you don't speak, using scripts and QA checklists we provide

Reliable delivery: you meet deadlines, communicate early if something slips, and never send a first draft as a final

Professional, low-drama communication over WhatsApp/Slack; you're fine with direct feedback and quick iteration

Available for at least 4 hours overlap with Central European Time



Nice to have



Understanding of Meta ad policy (no cure claims, no fabricated doctors or authority figures, no personal-attribute targeting language)

Experience reading ad metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA) and using them to guide re-cuts

Motion graphics / After Effects skills



How to apply

Send us:



Three video ads you've made, with a sentence each on what your role was and how they performed

Which AI video and voice tools you use, and one example made with them

Your availability and earliest start date

Put the word "OFFER" at the top of your message so we know you read this

title: Social Media Content Strategist & Manager
description:
We are a U.S.-based property services company looking for an experienced Social Media Content Strategist & Manager to take ownership of our social media content from beginning to end.



**This is NOT a social media assistant position. This is NOT a scheduling-only position. This is NOT a video-editor-only position.**



We need someone who has already managed social media content for a real business and has been responsible for the entire process:



Research → Ideation → Strategy → Content Planning → Filming Direction → Editing → Captions → Posting → Performance Review



You should be able to learn our business and audience, determine what content we should be creating and why, tell us what footage you need from us, turn that footage into polished content, and manage the publishing process.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



You will:



- Research our company, audience, niche, competitors, and relevant content trends.

- Develop content ideas and concepts without waiting for us to tell you what to post.

- Create and manage a monthly content strategy and calendar.

- Determine which ideas should become Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, carousels, graphics, or other content.

- Provide clear direction on what we need to film and how it should be filmed.

- Take raw footage we provide and turn it into polished, ready-to-post short-form videos.

- Create strong hooks and structure videos to keep viewers watching.

- Write natural, conversational captions and calls to action.

- Create simple branded graphics and static posts when appropriate.

- Schedule and publish content consistently.

- Repurpose content across Instagram, TikTok,
, and YouTube Shorts when appropriate.

- Monitor performance and use the data to determine what we should create, test, improve, or stop doing.

- Keep the entire content process organized from idea through publication.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You MUST have previous experience managing social media **for a business** from beginning to end.



We are specifically looking for someone who has personally been involved in:



Ideation + Strategy + Planning + Content Creation + Video Editing + Copywriting + Posting + Performance Review



You should also have:



- Strong short-form video editing skills.

- Experience with Instagram and TikTok content.

- Strong written English.

- A natural, conversational writing style.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Experience with Canva and video-editing software such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar.

- An understanding of hooks, retention, calls to action, and short-form video pacing.

- The ability to research and generate ideas independently.

- Excellent organization and the ability to manage a content calendar.

- The ability to work without being micromanaged.



PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



We are going to be very specific because we want to respect your time AND ours.



**DO NOT SEND A RESUME.



**DO NOT SEND A PORTFOLIO.



**DO NOT SEND A GOOGLE DRIVE LINK.



We are not looking for a folder of work that we have to search through.



Instead, send us 2–3 DIRECT LINKS to individual Instagram and/or TikTok posts that YOU personally worked on for a business.**



DO NOT SEND
 POST



The examples should be current or recent whenever possible and should demonstrate the type of work required for this position.



For EACH example, briefly tell us:



1. What was your role in creating this content?

For example: Did you come up with the idea? Write the script? Direct what was filmed? Edit the video? Write the caption? Post it?



2. Did you manage the business's overall social media content, or were you only responsible for this individual piece of content?



IMPORTANT:



If you do not have experience managing social media for a business, please do not apply.



If your experience is primarily video editing and someone else gives you the concepts, scripts, and footage, please do not apply.



If your experience is primarily creating graphics or Canva posts, please do not apply.



If your experience is primarily scheduling content that someone else creates, please do not apply.



If you have never been responsible for taking a business's social media content from ideation through posting, this position is not the right fit.



And please do not substitute a resume, portfolio, website, Google Drive folder, or general social media profile for the 2–3 specific Instagram/TikTok examples requested above.



Applications that do not include the requested examples will not be considered.



TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A brief introduction about your experience managing social media for businesses.



2. 2–3 direct links to specific Instagram and/or TikTok posts** you personally worked on. For each one, explain exactly what you were responsible for.



3. In a few sentences, walk us through your normal process when managing a business's social media from **initial research and content ideation all the way through editing, posting, and reviewing performance.



No resume needed. No portfolio needed. Just send us the information above.

title: Media Buyer
description:
We’re Hiring: Experienced Media Buyer



DigiPeak is looking for a sharp, experienced, and highly independent Media Buyer to join our team.



We’re looking for more than someone who knows how to set up campaigns.



We want someone who can think strategically, create winning advertising concepts, analyze performance, make smart decisions, and take ownership of results.



What you’ll be doing:



*Build, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other relevant channels

*Develop new ad angles, hooks, offers, messaging, and creative concepts

*Identify winning ads and understand why they work

*Continuously test creatives, audiences, targeting, landing pages, and campaign strategies

*Analyze performance and turn data into actionable decisions

*Find opportunities to improve CPA, ROAS, conversion rates, and overall profitability

*Scale winning campaigns while maintaining performance

*Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine what needs to change

*Conduct competitor, audience, and market research

*Manage advertising budgets responsibly

*Stay on top of new advertising strategies, platforms, and opportunities

*Take ownership of campaign performance from strategy through execution



Who we’re looking for:



You have real experience managing paid advertising campaigns and a strong understanding of performance marketing.



But technical experience alone isn’t enough.



We want someone who is smart, resourceful, analytical, and capable of thinking independently.



You should be someone who:



*Can look at a problem, investigate it, and d
 on the best course of action

*Thinks strategically rather than simply following an SOP

*Understands both the creative and analytical sides of advertising

*Can come up with strong ad concepts and testing ideas

*Uses data to make decisions without blindly following metrics

*Recognizes opportunities and acts on them

*Is comfortable making decisions and explaining the reasoning behind them

*Takes ownership and accountability for results

*Learns quickly and adapts when something isn't working

*Constantly looks for ways to improve performance



Experience we're looking for:



*Hands-on paid media buying experience

*Strong experience with Google Ads and/or Meta Ads

*Campaign optimization and scaling

*Creative testing and ad strategy

*Performance analysis and reporting

*Audience and competitor research

*Conversion-focused thinking

*Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets



Experience with TikTok Ads, YouTube, Microsoft Ads, native advertising, or other acquisition channels is a plus.



What matters most to us:



We don't want someone who just pushes buttons inside an ad platform. We want a problem solver and strategic thinker who understands advertising, can figure things out independently, and knows how to turn ideas and data into profitable campaigns.If you need detailed instructions for every decision, this probably isn't the right role. If you like experimenting, finding winning angles, scaling what works, and being trusted to make decisions, we'd like to hear from you.



To apply: Send your CV/resume and a short audio or video introduction. Include examples of campaigns you've managed, the platforms and budgets you've worked with, results you've achieved, and one example of a decision or strategy you personally came up with that significantly improved a campaign.

title: Commercial Real Estate Acquisitions & Underwriting Analyst
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are an established international luxury goods trading business, LuxuryLink Group, with a team of four. Under the L.L Capital name, we are evaluating our first commercial real estate acquisition as part of strengthening and expanding the business over the long term



Our founder previously worked in asset management at a REIT, overseeing industrial and commercial properties across several U.S. markets. We plan to apply that experience to acquire and operate our own portfolio, beginning with commercial properties valued between approximately US$1 million and US$5 million.



THE ROLE

We are looking for a resourceful and analytical real estate professional to help us develop our investment strategy and build our acquisition pipeline.

You will work directly with the founder across market research, deal sourcing, underwriting, and acquisition support. This is an opportunity to join at the beginning and help shape how the real estate platform operates.

This is not a general virtual assistant or residential cold-calling position. We are looking for someone with previous experience supporting a U.S. or Canadian commercial real estate investor, brokerage, developer, lender, appraisal firm, or acquisitions team.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

The role will begin with a market-selection project. You will help us compare potential Canadian and U.S. markets and determine where we should focus our initial acquisition efforts.

Your work will include:

Researching rents, vacancy, supply, demand, transaction volume, cap rates, and property values

Comparing markets using a clear and consistent framework

Identifying properties within our target price range

Speaking with brokers and market participants to validate the research

Helping define target markets, property types, return requirements, and acquisition criteria

Presenting clear recommendations supported by reliable data

Once the initial strategy is established, you will help build and manage our acquisition pipeline by:

Finding on-market and off-market commercial properties

Researching owners, decision-makers, brokers, and contact information

Monitoring new, stale, withdrawn, and expired listings

Building targeted property and owner lists

Supporting professional outreach and follow-up

Maintaining an organized acquisitions CRM

Preparing weekly updates on opportunities and next steps



UNDERWRITING

You will help evaluate potential acquisitions by:

Reviewing offering memorandums, rent rolls, leases, and operating statements

Reconstructing and normalizing property income and expenses

Calculating in-place and stabilized NOI

Reviewing rents, vacancy, tenant concentration, and lease rollover

Researching comparable rents and property sales

Modeling purchase costs, capital expenditures, financing, and debt service

Calculating cap rate, cash-on-cash return, equity multiple, and IRR

Preparing base and downside scenarios

Identifying important risks, missing information, and unsupported assumptions

Preparing concise investment summaries with a clear recommendation

We want someone who can question the numbers—not simply enter broker-provided figures into a spreadsheet.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Previous commercial real estate experience

Familiarity with U.S. or Canadian real estate markets

Understanding of NOI, cap rates, leases, rent rolls, and operating statements

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

Excellent research and analytical ability

Fluent written and spoken English

Strong attention to detail and follow-through

Ability to work independently and communicate conclusions clearly

Experience with commercial real estate databases, acquisition models, owner research, CRM systems, or off-market sourcing is a strong advantage.



PERSONALITY FIT

You are curious, resourceful, and comfortable working through incomplete information

You can explain why a property should or should not be pursued

You distinguish verified facts from assumptions

You follow up consistently without being reminded

You enjoy finding opportunities that other people overlook

You bring ideas from your previous experience

If you say something is complete, it is accurate and ready to use



COMPENSATION & GROWTH

Compensation is US$500–$650 per month for approximately 20 hours per week, depending on experience and demonstrated ability. This is a consistent monthly position rather than occasional hourly or freelance work.

We are beginning part-time while we establish our investment strategy and acquisition pipeline. If we successfully build the platform and there is sufficient ongoing work, we would be open to transitioning the right person into a full-time salaried position if it makes sense for both parties.

As the platform grows, there may also be opportunities for increased responsibility, compensation growth, and performance-based incentives.



HOW TO APPLY

To apply, send a message through this platform with your resume and a short note covering: what commercial real estate work you have done before, a property or deal you helped research or underwrite, and how you would approach comparing different markets for potential investment.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short video call. Applications without a note will not be reviewed.
